Tips.SourceString: 突击步枪，满足以猛烈的火力压制战场的需求，其精准度和射速的平衡性也相当出色。配备1.25倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: Relentless firepower to dominate the battlefield, offering an excellent balance of accuracy and firing rate. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “丛林”系列涂装，以绿色为主体的枪身点缀少量橙色条带，虽谈不上华丽，实用性却极强。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Jungle" series features a primarily green gun body with subtle orange stripes. Not the prettiest tool in the shed, but it gets the job done.

Tips.SourceString: “警戒”系列涂装，PUS-04定制款，鲜明醒目，欧泊阵营中随处可见。
Tips.LocalizedString: The popular P.U.S-04 Vigilance adds a bright and distinctive finish to the P.U.S arsenal.

Tips.SourceString: “彩斑”系列涂装，以复数颜料色带涂抹而成，看似随性，却有艺术的气息喷薄而出。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the Colorburst series. Painted with streaks of different pigments. This firearm has a casual vibe, but it's overflowing with artistic flair.

Tips.SourceString: “雷火”系列涂装，橙灰交错，复古的同时融入了潮流元素。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Thunderfire series blends contemporary sleekness with retro orange-gray elements.

Tips.SourceString: “碎梦”系列涂装，由不规则蓝色色块堆叠而成，图案中偶尔掺杂少量黄色碎片，给人以强烈的破碎感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Dreambreaker series combines patchy blues with occasional yellow fragments for a striking, shattered effect.

Tips.SourceString: “炫彩”系列涂装，由大量六边形色块重叠而成，斑斓的色彩效果甚至令人有种火力增强的错觉。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Vivid" series. Made up of a variety of overlapping hexagonal color blocks, this firearm's streams of color give off the illusion of added firepower.

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的个性化定制涂装，这款涂装诉说着米雪儿相信的一个真理。
“皮肤越粉，打人越狠。”
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized paint job of the Inspector. It tells of a truth Michele has always believed in.
“The pinker the skin, the stronger the blow.”

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的个性化定制涂装，米雪儿的Q版形象也跃动了起来。
“斗鱼莫夫，打到你哭。”
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized paint job of the Inspector. Michele is also lovingly animated in Chibi style.
“You will beg for mercy.”

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的个性化定制涂装，这份涂装纪念着米雪儿第一次完成任务时的笑脸。
 “小小先锋，准备突击！”
Tips.LocalizedString:
The personalized Inspector paint job commemorates Michele's smile upon completing her first quest.

"Vanguard, ready for assault!"

Tips.SourceString: “冲浪”系列涂装，使用简约的色块勾勒出了沙滩与海浪的景象，拿在手上仿佛也能乘上海浪勇往直前。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Wave Surfer" series evokes beachside wave imagery with its minimalist blockish color design.

Tips.SourceString: “锦鲤”系列涂装，斑驳的红黑配色如同火药与烈焰，希望面对它的人能够走运。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Koi" series features a red and black pattern reminiscent of fire and gunpowder, bringing good luck to those who encounter it.

Tips.SourceString: “编织”系列涂装，吸收了传统时尚单品的设计理念，色彩搭配简洁而大胆，是彰显品味的装扮。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Weave" series draws inspiration from classic fashion pieces, featuring simple yet bold colors, perfect for showcasing style.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“棉花糖”系列枪械造型，可爱的头像设计，别具一格的渐变色枪身，曾一度风靡于欧泊的年轻搜查官之中。
Tips.LocalizedString: Manufactured by Polaris Labs, the Cotton Candy series features cute avatar designs and unique ombré barrels, and was once a favorite among the young investigators of P.U.S.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“主角之星”系列枪械造型，为客户特殊定制个性化形象并将其融入枪身设计中，堪称定制枪械设计的典范。
Tips.LocalizedString: Protagonist Star series produced by Polaris Labs, a classic example of stylistic design incorporating the client's very specific demands.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“纸牌屋”系列枪械造型，枪身中央有着客户定制的艺术头像，四周环绕的卡牌装饰，俏皮中略带几分神秘。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series from Corridor Artisans gained its intriguing reputation from the client's meticulous requirements for an avatar encircled by decorative card elements.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“招财猫”系列枪械造型，以象征着开运的招财猫为设计锚点，表达了设计者对客户们的美好祝福。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Maneki-Neko" series by Polaris Labs uses the symbol of the good fortune cat as its design anchor, expressing the creator's best wishes for clients.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“纸牌屋”系列枪械造型，枪身中央有着客户定制的艺术头像，四周环绕的卡牌装饰，俏皮中略带几分神秘。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series from Corridor Artisans gained its intriguing reputation from the client's meticulous requirements for an avatar encircled by decorative card elements.

Tips.SourceString: “暗金浪涌”系列主题涂装，由偏光实验室推出的枪械涂装，主打暗金色调，在保证酷炫拉风的同时，也颇具金属般的沉稳感与力量感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Golden Surge" series, launched by Polaris Labs, features a dark gold pattern that combines a cool, flashy look with a powerful sense of metallic stability.

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的个人定制款，甜蜜的外表下隐藏着巨大的危险——名为卡路里的少女天敌。

【唔……这个巧克力弹夹做的好逼真啊，悄悄藏一个应该没关系吧？】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The custom Inspector design. Beneath its sweet exterior lurks a girl's biggest foe—calories.

"These chocolate mags look so tasty... I'm sure a bite would be fine... right?"

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的概念客制型号，大胆地将熔岩效果融入枪身，流动的纹路里仿佛点燃了炼狱的火光。

【硫磺火湖之间，正义仍存。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Inspector concept model daringly integrates lava effects into its design, with flowing patterns that evoke the flames of purgatory.

“Amid sulfur and fire, justice prevails.”

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的火力改造型，专为战争而生，内置的脉冲系统大幅强化了枪械性能，实战中甚至能起到决定胜负的作用。

【枪火的洪流倾轧而过，将一切都化作余烬。
复仇的意志便有如钢铁，咆哮着于心底发出不甘的愤懑。
我们并不知晓战争的初衷为何，
但战争的手段，与正义无关。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
This war edition of the Inspector features a built-in pulse system that can influence real battle outcomes.

"A torrent of gunfire reduces everything to ashes. The will for vengeance roars with unyielding fury. We may not know why wars begin, but their means have nothing to do with justice."

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的冬日定制款，兼顾了伪装性和可爱的特点，经过特殊处理的枪身也不会因为在低温状态下而失灵，米雪儿在挑战赛期间的爱用涂装。

【“悄悄地接近，像是雪豹一样行动！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A winter edition of the Inspector, blending camouflage with cuteness. Specially treated to ensure reliable performance even in the cold, it's Michele's favorite for challenges.

“Approach silently, like a snow leopard!”

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的概念客制型，蓝白交错间缠绕流金，看上去华丽又气派。可爱的棒球装饰，又为这柄武器增添了些许俏皮的要素。跑垒成功，赢取胜利！

【“这颗棒球，是盗垒成功的纪念品哦！”
擦去额上的汗水，米雪儿露出了灿烂的微笑。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized concept version of the Inspector. Glided with blue and white strips, it is both luxurious and stylish. A cute baseball decoration adds a splash of playfulness to this weapon. Run the bases and win!

"This baseball is a souvenir for stealing a base!"
Michele smiles brightly as she wipes the sweat from her brow.

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的个人定制款，综合考虑了米雪儿的作战习惯以及她的小爱好，在怒浪翻涌中，告诫来者，她可也不是好惹的。

【“你们差一点就能打中米雪儿船长了！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Inspector custom edition, tailored to Michele's combat style and quirks, serves as a warning amid the raging waves that she is not someone to mess with.

“You almost hit Captain Michele!”

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的个人定制款，想成为雀神，不仅需要时运，也需要把握时运的技巧和勇气。正好，超级玩家米雪儿俩样都不缺。

【杠！杠！杠！杠上开花，大四喜，十八罗汉！】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The custom Inspector model requires not just luck to become the God of Mahjong, but also the skill and courage to seize it. Fortunately, Michele has both in spades.

"Kong! Kong! Kong! Blossoming from a Kong, Big Four Winds, All Honours!"

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的“沐春节”特供版，以东方神话中的龙为主体形象，鲜红的涂装与四溢的火焰，与米雪儿参加烟花庆典时的心情一样热烈。

【“不如让我来打响新年的第一响吧？嘿嘿，开玩笑啦。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Spring Blessings edition of the Inspector, features a Loong from Eastern mythology. The vibrant red design and blazing flames match Michele's excitement during the fireworks festival.

“How about I fire the first shot of the New Year? Hehe, just kidding."

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的泳池派对限定版，是米雪儿在水枪大赛中荣获第一名的战利品。虽然看上去外形很可爱，但其实威力不小呢，就和米雪儿本人一样。

【“好想每年夏天都可以参加水枪大赛啊！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Inspector pool party edition is Michele's prize for winning first in the water gun contest. It may look cute, but it's surprisingly powerful.

"I really wish I could enter the water gun contest every summer!"

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的田园生活改造款。在乡村度假的米雪儿偶然发现一只胖胖的流浪猫，担心流浪猫生活问题的米雪儿一路尾随，最终在森林深处找到了它的树屋，并以此为灵感设计了该涂装。

【“看到小胖躺在树梢晒太阳的样子，我也想住进它的树屋了……”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
This countryside-inspired Inspector model was designed during Michele’s rural getaway. After spotting a chubby stray cat, Michele followed it to a treehouse deep in the woods, which sparked the idea for this design.

"The plump little cat is enjoying the sun on the treetop. It really makes me want to move into its treehouse…"

Tips.SourceString: “警探”的校园日定制款，为宣传电竞社新作进行的游戏化涂装，是少女迫不及待地将热爱与人分享的证明。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Campus Open Day edition of the Inspector features a gamified design to promote the Esports Club. It symbolizes Michele's eagerness to share her passion with others.

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的搜查官射击竞赛定制款涂装，一体化的喷涂设计提供充分的视觉辨识度，确保射手在运动射击中的英姿能够被完美地捕捉和记录。

【“更快的速度，更强的战术，更新的纪录，参与比赛，就该全力以赴！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The custom Inspector model for shooting competitions enhances visibility, capturing your epic form during dynamic shooting.

"Faster, stronger, and record-breaking—compete with everything you've got!"

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的概念客制款涂装，专为获得大满贯的米雪儿选手定制。红黑配色彰显了她所获的荣耀，而停留在枪身的创可贴装饰则是她付出心血的证明。

【“努力和汗水不会辜负任何人，我的成功就是最好的证明！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Inspector Grand Slam edition flaunts red and black hues for a touch of prestige, while the band-aid decorations on the gun represent her dedication and effort.

"Hard work and perseverance never fail. My achievements are the perfect proof!"

Tips.SourceString:
“警探”的私人定制款，漆黑枪身上印有白虎纹章，蓝色的能量光芒于枪体流转。持枪者将以最坚定的意志，前往执行正义的第一线。

【 当米雪儿提交改造申请的时候，偏光实验室的研究员直呼离谱，不可能有人控制好这么狂暴的弦能。
“别瞎担心，我可是米雪儿·李，要掌握比黄昏更为昏暗的东西也是小菜一碟！” 】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The custom Inspector features a white tiger emblem on the dark barrel, glowing with pulsating blue energy. Its wielder, armed with unwavering resolve, charges into the frontline of justice.

When Michele submitted her modification request, the researchers at Polaris Labs were taken aback, doubting anyone could handle such wild string energy.
"Relax! I’m Michele—harnessing extra string energy is child's play for me!"

Tips.SourceString: 突击步枪，性能可靠、火力强大，性价比奇高。对恶劣环境有高耐性，输出能力稳定，堪称强悍与适性的完美融合。配备1.25倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: This high-performance, weather-resistant assault rifle delivers powerful firepower and unbeatable value. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “蜂巢”系列涂装，充满科技感的蓝紫色，赋以六角形的边界图案，体现出严谨而精密的科学之美。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Hive" series features a tech-inspired blue and purple theme with hexagrammic border designs, showcasing the beauty of precise and meticulous science.

Tips.SourceString: “多维”系列涂装，以卡拉彼丘图案为设计锚点，简约却不简单的图形中，流溢着别样的设计魅力。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Multiverse" series features a Strinova-inspired design. Its simple yet intricate patterns exude a unique charm.

Tips.SourceString: “热情”系列涂装，URB-00定制款，艳丽乖张的色彩彰显最为新潮的理念，深受乌尔比诺成员的喜爱。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Ardor" series, URB-00 custom edition, features vibrant, edgy colors that reflect the latest trends, and is a favorite among Urbino members.

Tips.SourceString: “错觉”系列涂装，以蓝色调为主，混合扭曲的色彩看似在流动一般，表现出复杂动态的变形之美。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Illusion" series, this firearm's blue highlights twist and turn, as if melting into the design.

Tips.SourceString: “嵌合”系列涂装，深浓浅淡，错落有致的橙色马赛克涂装，带来独特而充满视觉效果的艺术感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Chimera" series features an elegant orange mosaic design with deep and light tones, creating an artistic look.

Tips.SourceString: “锦鲤”系列涂装，斑驳的红黑配色如同火药与烈焰，希望面对它的人能够走运。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Koi" series features a red and black pattern reminiscent of fire and gunpowder, bringing good luck to those who encounter it.

Tips.SourceString: “棱镜”系列涂装，不同深浅的紫红色调，仿佛在棱镜碎片中折射，显现出万花筒一般的美感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Prisma" series uses refractive fragmentation, with artistic purple shades evoking a kaleidoscopic feeling.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“占星”系列枪械造型，神秘与潮流的结合，长廊绘制所内画师们的呕心沥血之作。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Astrologist" series by Corridor Artisans is a careful blend of mystery and trend, said to be the painstaking work of their top artist.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“纸牌屋”系列枪械造型，枪身中央有着客户定制的艺术头像，四周环绕的卡牌装饰，俏皮中略带几分神秘。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series from Corridor Artisans gained its intriguing reputation from the client's meticulous requirements for an avatar encircled by decorative card elements.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“幻海”系列枪械造型，将海洋元素融入枪身之内，又附以如梦似幻的渐变配色，大大加强了枪械的整体艺术感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Mystic Ocean" series by Corridor Artisans beautifully blends oceanic elements with dreamlike gradient colors, enhancing the firearm's artistic appeal.

Tips.SourceString: 格罗夫集团出品，“回味时光”咖啡厅同名主题涂装，依据持有者的喜好进行了个性化设计。不论是难眠的深夜，亦或是悠闲的午后，这杯咖啡都为你带来了一段值得回味的香浓时光。
Tips.LocalizedString: Produced by Grove Enterprises, the "Café Reminiscence" themed design is personalized according to the owner's taste. Whether it's a restless night or a relaxing afternoon, this coffee will bring you a rich and memorable experience.

Tips.SourceString: “禁区”系列涂装，为适应科斯迷特沙漠环境而进行再配色的制式涂装，有着良好的隐蔽性。其上的警示图标也是准入该地区的“凭证”之一。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Forbidden" series showcases a standard paint job adapted for improved concealment in Cosmite's environment. Its pronounced warning label is as good as any permit.

Tips.SourceString:
欺诈师的魔术秀颁奖典礼特供版，切莫被那羽美丽的红翎所迷惑，她的魔术既华丽而目不暇接，却也致命而危机四伏。

【“接下来表演的是，子弹消失魔术……骗你的，现在你可逃不掉了~”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special Magicians' Awards edition of the Gambit. Don't be fooled by the alluring red feathers; her magic is as dazzling as it is deadly.

“Next up, I'll make bullets disappear... Just kidding. There's no escape for you now.”

Tips.SourceString:
“欺诈师”的泳池派对特供版，参考了贝壳的流线型设计，辅之以海水、沙滩和木槿花的色调，呈现出复古的浪漫。
【“播放下一首曲子之前，去吧台边拿杯饮料吧，夜晚还很长呢。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special pool party edition of the Gambit. Inspired by seashells, the streamlined design features colors of seawater, beaches, and hibiscus, exuding a retro, romantic feeling.

"Before you play the next song, grab a drink at the bar. The night is still young."

Tips.SourceString:
“欺诈师”的改造版本，加入了大量的羽毛要素，在造型上降低威胁感。据使用者本人所说，外观也是欺诈的一环。

【“目眩神迷，魄散魂飞！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A reimagined "Gambit" with plentiful feather details for a less intimidating look. The user claims even its appearance plays into the deception.

"Dazzling and spellbinding!"

Tips.SourceString:
“欺诈师”的打歌舞台定制版，以麦克风为装饰，辅之以跳跃的音符，当加拉蒂亚的歌声不知从何处传来时，也许你已经走入了她的陷阱。

【“喜欢我的歌声吗？那就多听几遍吧。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The customized stage version of the Gambit is adorned with a microphone and floating musical notes. When you suddenly hear Galatea's voice, you may have already stepped into her trap.

"Do you like my singing? You're in for a treat."

Tips.SourceString:
“欺诈师”的仿古定制版，按照“幻梦求真录”历史文化展览中的古文明壁画一比一复刻，执于手中，仿佛能将时间回溯，亲眼感受文明绚烂的那个年代。

【“遥遥云上舞，窈窕祥云仙。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
This retro Gambit model replicates ancient murals from the "Dreams to Reality" historical exhibit. In your hands, it evokes an era of civilization's brilliance.

"A celestial dance in timeless skies."

Tips.SourceString:
“欺诈师”的耐力赛定制版，以简易赛道作为涂装。这是作为赛车手的加拉蒂亚最熟悉的领域。

【“哪有什么一眨眼就追了上来，我只是每个弯道都在提速而已~”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Gambit's endurance race edition showcases a sleek track design, tailored to racer Galatea's expertise.

"I didn’t catch up in the blink of an eye—I just accelerated on every curve!"

Tips.SourceString:
“欺诈师”的电玩比赛定制版，枪身涂装采用了和服装相同的概念，以加拉蒂亚童年最喜欢的太空飞船射击游戏为设计元素。

【“真怀念小时候和妹妹一起玩游戏的时光啊，那孩子一输就会忍不住哭鼻子呢，真可爱。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The arcade-themed Gambit features a gun skin designed to match the clothing, inspired by Galatea's favorite childhood space shooter game.

"I miss those childhood days playing games with my sister. She'd cry when she lost; it was adorable."

Tips.SourceString: 突击步枪，无托系列步枪中的代表之作，综合素质极其优秀，古地球轻武器中的经典。配备1.25倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: The standout bullpup rifle, known for its exceptional all-around performance. A classic from old Earth firearms. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “彩斑”系列涂装，以复数颜料色带涂抹而成，看似随性，却有艺术的气息喷薄而出。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the Colorburst series. Painted with streaks of different pigments. This firearm has a casual vibe, but it's overflowing with artistic flair.

Tips.SourceString: “炫彩”系列涂装，由大量六边形色块重叠而成，斑斓的色彩效果甚至令人有种火力增强的错觉。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Vivid" series. Made up of a variety of overlapping hexagonal color blocks, this firearm's streams of color give off the illusion of added firepower.

Tips.SourceString: “警戒”系列涂装，PUS-04定制款，鲜明醒目，欧泊阵营中随处可见。
Tips.LocalizedString: The popular P.U.S-04 Vigilance adds a bright and distinctive finish to the P.U.S arsenal.

Tips.SourceString: “碎梦”系列涂装，由不规则蓝色色块堆叠而成，图案中偶尔掺杂少量黄色碎片，给人以强烈的破碎感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Dreambreaker series combines patchy blues with occasional yellow fragments for a striking, shattered effect.

Tips.SourceString: “雷火”系列涂装，橙灰交错，复古的同时融入了潮流元素。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Thunderfire series blends contemporary sleekness with retro orange-gray elements.

Tips.SourceString: “落日”系列定制涂装，橙白色的渐变预示着敌人的黑夜将至。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Sunset" series features a tasteful orange-white gradient, symbolizing the coming of twilight.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“夏日派对”系列枪械造型，整体洋溢着轻松活跃的氛围，在战斗中甚至能起到鼓舞士气的作用。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Summer Party series by Polaris Labs exudes a relaxed and lively vibe. This firearm can boost morale even in the heat of battle.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“招财猫”系列枪械造型，以象征着开运的招财猫为设计锚点，表达了设计者对客户们的美好祝福。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Maneki-Neko" series by Polaris Labs uses the symbol of the good fortune cat as its design anchor, expressing the creator's best wishes for clients.

Tips.SourceString: “禁区”系列涂装，为适应科斯迷特沙漠环境而进行再配色的制式涂装，有着良好的隐蔽性。其上的警示图标也是准入该地区的“凭证”之一。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Forbidden" series showcases a standard paint job adapted for improved concealment in Cosmite's environment. Its pronounced warning label is as good as any permit.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“纸牌屋”系列枪械造型，枪身中央有着客户定制的艺术头像，四周环绕的卡牌装饰，俏皮中略带几分神秘。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series from Corridor Artisans gained its intriguing reputation from the client's meticulous requirements for an avatar encircled by decorative card elements.

Tips.SourceString: “掠食者”系列涂装，仿生迷彩的设计不仅提供了良好的复杂环境隐蔽能力，也象征着战士们强大的武力。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Predator series features a bionic camo design, offering excellent camouflage in complex environments.

Tips.SourceString: 红梅落于雪上，馥郁芬芳，心也在这份冷冽中变得宁静。
Tips.LocalizedString: Red blossoms rest on snow, their fragrance calming the mind amid the chill.

Tips.SourceString:
“绝对执行”的换装舞会定制版。灰天鹅在水面翩然起舞，轻盈的羽毛随风飘散，落在手心时却又消散，只化作一滴眼泪。

【“我并没有学过跳舞，这些舞步只是对书本和影碟呈现的拙劣模仿。既然你们觉得还不错，那我判断模仿这种方式是行之有效的。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Retribution ball edition captures the elegant dance of a gray swan on water. Feathers drift gracefully and vanish into tears upon touch.

"I never learned to dance formally; my steps are just imperfect imitations from books and films. Since you find it acceptable, I conclude that imitation works well enough."

Tips.SourceString:
“绝对执行”的打歌舞台定制版。以热闹的音乐节现场为背景，话筒、耳麦、键盘、舞台……每一处细节与忧雾的适配度都为百分百。

【“成为一名被喜爱的偶像……有更详细一点的指令吗？没有也没关系，我会做到的。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Retribution music fest edition is tailored for an electrifying stage show. With a bustling backdrop of mics, headsets, and keyboards, every detail perfectly complements Yugiri's style.

"To become a beloved idol... Are there more specific instructions? No worries, I'll make it happen."

Tips.SourceString:
“绝对执行”的沐春节定制款。从实验室逃出来之前，忧雾从没有见过真正的雪，但她非常喜欢这些冰冰凉凉、晶莹剔透的小东西。因此在改装枪械时，她也设法把一小片雪留了下来。

【“不会消逝的雪花……这是关于冬天，最美好的记忆。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Retribution Spring Blessing edition. Before breaking free from the lab, Yugiri had never encountered real snow, yet she found those icy, shimmering flakes enchanting. She made sure to add a touch of snow to her weapon's redesign.

"Snow that never melts… the most treasured memory of winter."

Tips.SourceString:
“绝对执行”的游乐园限定涂装，设计灵感来源于游乐园内人气最高的抓娃娃机。琳琅满目的娃娃机和各式各样的毛绒玩具让忧雾流连忘返，最终也满载而归。

【“不知道为什么，币好像用不完一样，所以我抓了一个又一个……是谁的币放错在了我的包里吗？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Retribution amusement park edition is inspired by the most popular attraction—the claw machine. Surrounded by colorful plush toys, Yugiri couldn't help but indulge and left with a full haul.

"For some reason, the coins just didn't run out, so I kept grabbing more and more... Did someone mix up their coins with mine?"

Tips.SourceString: 突击步枪，满足以猛烈的火力压制战场的需求，其精准度和射速的平衡性也相当出色。配备1.25倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: Relentless firepower to dominate the battlefield, offering an excellent balance of accuracy and firing rate. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “破碎线条”系列涂装，线条的断点恰到好处，增加了视觉的冲击力，以极简的设计传递出了颇具层次与不和谐的美感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Fractured Lines series uses artfully broken lines to enhance visual impact. Its minimalist design conveys a layered and discordant beauty.

Tips.SourceString: "碎梦"系列涂装，由不规则蓝色色块堆叠而成，图案中偶尔掺杂少量黄色碎片，给人以强烈的破碎感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Dreambreaker series combines patchy blues with occasional yellow fragments for a striking, shattered effect.

Tips.SourceString: “跃动”系列涂装，色彩炫丽时尚，富有活力激情，该涂装系列在新晋剪刀手成员之间颇受欢迎。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Vibrancy series boasts a colorful and energetic design, making it a favorite among new members of The Scissors.

Tips.SourceString: “叛逆”系列涂装，色彩搭配反差感极强，图案设计状如一道迅捷有力的闪电，恰到好处地诠释了反叛与不羁的精神。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Rebel series features a striking color contrast and a pattern design resembling a swift, powerful lightning bolt, perfectly capturing the spirit of rebellion and defiance.

Tips.SourceString: “青春迷彩”系列涂装，经过某位白芸艺术馆设计师改良设计，颜色更加活泼明快，颇具青春的气息。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Youthful Camo series, redesigned by a Cloudscape Gallery designer, features vibrant and lively colors, exuding a fresh, youthful vibe.

Tips.SourceString: “红与黑”系列涂装，以剪刀手的标志色为主色调，反叛色彩与不拘一格的形状诉说着剪刀手的反叛精神，这种涂装在老一派剪刀手成员中非常常见。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Riot series features The Scissors' iconic colors and an unconventional design that symbolizes their rebellious nature, making this design popular among veteran members.

Tips.SourceString: “锦鲤”系列涂装，斑驳的红黑配色如同火药与烈焰，希望面对它的人能够走运。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Koi" series features a red and black pattern reminiscent of fire and gunpowder, bringing good luck to those who encounter it.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“浪人”系列枪械造型，神秘迷幻的紫色枪身中仿佛有浪花跃动，抚慰着每一位浪人的心。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Ronin series produced by Quadrant Foundries features waves dancing on a mysterious and psychedelic purple background, soothing the hearts of many wandering warriors.

Tips.SourceString:
由象限工造出品的"夏日海滩"系列枪械造型，完美地将不同种类的海滩元素附着于枪身之上，宁
静时刻，甚至能听见海潮的回响。
Tips.LocalizedString: Manufactured by Quadrant Foundries, the Summer Beach series of firearms perfectly blends various beach elements onto the barrel. In tranquil moments, you might even hear the echo of the waves.

Tips.SourceString: “禁区”系列涂装，为适应科斯迷特沙漠环境而进行再配色的制式涂装，有着良好的隐蔽性。其上的警示图标也是准入该地区的“凭证”之一。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Forbidden" series showcases a standard paint job adapted for improved concealment in Cosmite's environment. Its pronounced warning label is as good as any permit.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“纸牌屋”系列枪械造型，枪身中央有着客户定制的艺术头像，四周环绕的卡牌装饰，俏皮中略带几分神秘。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series from Corridor Artisans gained its intriguing reputation from the client's meticulous requirements for an avatar encircled by decorative card elements.

Tips.SourceString: “掠食者”系列涂装，仿生迷彩的设计不仅提供了良好的复杂环境隐蔽能力，也象征着战士们强大的武力。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Predator series features a bionic camo design, offering excellent camouflage in complex environments.

Tips.SourceString:
“绽放”的改装版本。就像她平常用香氛治愈队友的损伤一样，改装后的武器也嵌合了鼓舞队友精神的功能。

【“别担心，我会让那些不和谐的声息停下来。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A modified version of the Blossom. It allows Fragrans to rally her allies in addition to healing them.

"Don't worry. I'll drown out those discordant sounds."

Tips.SourceString:
“绽放”的沙漠特化版本，通过材质与外形模仿了树脂析出枝干的过程，传闻在开火时会散发出木腊的香气，只可惜对手是没有机会闻到了。
【“真遗憾，沙漠中看不到太多的花呢。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Blossom desert edition mimics the process of resin-seeping branches through its material and design. Rumor has it, it releases a woody aroma when fired—though, sadly, the target won't have a chance to enjoy it.

"What a pity. There aren't many flowers in the desert."

Tips.SourceString:
“绽放”的医用特供版，依照使用者的需求添加了香芯插槽，是易用性至上的设计。
【你能嗅到……其中的危险吗？】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special medical model of Blossom. Features an incense slot and a design that prioritizes usability.

"Can you smell that...? It's the scent of danger."

Tips.SourceString:
“绽放”的沐春节特殊定制款。传说中长着焰尾的锦鲤能带来好运，珐格兰丝以“锦鲤”为主题，改造了自己的武器。希望在新一年，她所研制的香氛也能为大家带去好运。

【“这款香氛，就叫‘锦鲤’吧。说不定能提高我们战斗的胜率呢。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Spring Blessing edition of Blossom. Known for its fiery tail, the legendary koi symbolizes good luck. Inspired by this theme, Fragrans customized her weapon, hoping her newly developed aroma will bring everyone luck in the new year.

"Let's name this aroma Koi. Maybe it'll help boost our battle win rate."

Tips.SourceString:
“绽放”的暗黑哥特风格改装版，枪支上装饰着珐格兰丝精心培育的卡特兰。如果一定要让人们陷入沉睡，那么至少能送上一曲安魂的挽歌。

【“不会痛苦的，只是伴着花香做了个长久的美梦。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Gothic-style Blossom is adorned with Cattleya orchids, carefully cultivated by Fragrans. If slumber is inevitable, let a requiem accompany it.

"There will be no pain, only a long, sweet dream enveloped in the fragrance of flowers."

Tips.SourceString: 突击步枪，性能可靠、火力强大，性价比奇高。对恶劣环境有高耐性，输出能力稳定，堪称强悍与适性的完美融合。配备1.25倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: This high-performance, weather-resistant assault rifle delivers powerful firepower and unbeatable value. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “浪潮”系列涂装，以蓝色色块组合模拟海浪的造型，虽无潮声，却也沁人心脾。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Tidal Wave" series is composed of a series of blue modules meant to imitate the shape of a wave. It may lack the sound of the sea, but it remains a delight.

Tips.SourceString: “霓虹”系列涂装，SCIS-08定制款，叛逆不羁的色彩搭配，受到剪刀手阵营的青睐。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Neon" SCIS-08 custom edition showcases The Scissors' bold rebellion with its edgy color scheme.

Tips.SourceString: “紫金”系列涂装，别出心裁的紫金撞色搭配给予枪身别样的质感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Violet Gold series features a unique blend of purple and gold, giving the weapon a distinct texture.

Tips.SourceString: “迷彩”系列涂装，枪身上多样的色彩融合，很好地达到了融入自然环境的效果。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Camo" series. The firearm features perfect textures to blend seamlessly into natural environments.

Tips.SourceString: “信念”系列涂装，黑底，配上剪刀手徽记与涂鸦，肃杀中彰显出持有者坚定的意志。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Faith" series features a black base with The Scissors emblem, showcasing the holder's unwavering resolve.

Tips.SourceString: “魅紫”系列涂装，以明亮的紫色填充枪身，赋予枪身独特的神秘感。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Arcane Purple" series, this firearm, adorned in bright purple, exudes a sense of mystery.

Tips.SourceString: “交错线”系列涂装，以暗色为敌，用交叉，叠加的线条作为主要的图形，在视觉上具有一定的迷惑性。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Crisscross series features a dark base with intersecting lines, creating a dazzling display on the battlefield.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“浪人”系列枪械造型，神秘迷幻的紫色枪身中仿佛有浪花跃动，抚慰着每一位浪人的心。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Ronin series produced by Quadrant Foundries features waves dancing on a mysterious and psychedelic purple background, soothing the hearts of many wandering warriors.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“夏日海滩”系列枪械造型，完美地将不同种类的海滩元素附着于枪身之上，宁静时刻，甚至能听见海潮的回响。
Tips.LocalizedString: Manufactured by Quadrant Foundries, the Summer Beach series of firearms perfectly blends various beach elements onto the barrel. In tranquil moments, you might even hear the echo of the waves.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“Q版世界”系列枪械造型，将定制者的Q版三视图融入视觉设计中，为枪身赋予轻松气息的同时，更好地满足了客制化需求。
Tips.LocalizedString: Manufactured by Quadrant Foundries, the "Chibi World" series of firearms features custom Chibi-style art, adding a relaxed vibe to the barrel while fulfilling customization needs.

Tips.SourceString: “纸牌屋”系列涂装，以红心黑方作为主题，身着华服的Q版剪刀手成员惟妙惟肖，彰显贵气之感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series features a tasteful heart and black square palette, adorned with elegant chibi versions of The Scissors, exuding a sense of luxury.

Tips.SourceString: “龙腾虎跃”系列涂装，以黄白二色凸显喜庆之感，刻画舞狮的剪刀手队员们跃然而上，凸显龙马精神。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Lion Dance" series features a festive yellow and white design, depicting Scissors members performing lion dances, embodying spirit and vitality.

Tips.SourceString: “禁区”系列涂装，为适应科斯迷特沙漠环境而进行再配色的制式涂装，有着良好的隐蔽性。其上的警示图标也是准入该地区的“凭证”之一。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Forbidden" series showcases a standard paint job adapted for improved concealment in Cosmite's environment. Its pronounced warning label is as good as any permit.

Tips.SourceString:
以“逆焰”为蓝本，由象限工造重新设计的尖端武器，在保留逆焰基础造型的同时，对枪械整体性能进行了不止一个层级的拔高。

【科技的进步，究竟需要怎样的催化剂？
——很简单，只要有战争就够了。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Based on the Rebelflame, this cutting-edge weapon has been redesigned by Quadrant Foundries, enhancing its overall performance while retaining its original form.

"What catalyst drives scientific progress? It's simple: war."

Tips.SourceString:
以“逆焰”为原型，象限工造全面更新的型号。银灰色为主体的金属枪身，暗暗的红光，透出凛凛的杀意。

【我们的意志坚如钢铁。
让我们一起，把压迫者的高塔烧成灰。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Based on the Rebelflame, Quadrant Foundries introduces a fully updated model. Featuring a silver-gray metal body with a subtle red glow, it radiates a fierce intent.

"Our will is as strong as steel.
Together, we will burn the oppressors to ashes."

Tips.SourceString:
模仿“逆焰”，水枪造型的创意型号。可别把这把枪当成玩具，明可不会手下留情。

【唱起来吧，伙伴们，让我们一同歌唱。
为了自由，为了故土，为了我们的理想。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A creative water gun model inspired by the Rebelflame. Don't mistake it for a toy—Ming shows no mercy.

"Let us sing, my friends. For freedom. For the motherland. For our ideals."

Tips.SourceString:
“逆焰”的个人定制款，鹰隼的敏锐与牛仔的潇洒集于一身，恰到好处地诠释了牛仔的勇敢无畏与狂放自由。

【被这只“雄鹰”盯上的猎物，绝对逃不掉。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized "Rebelflame," blending the sharpness of an eagle with the free spirit of a cowboy, perfectly captures a maverick's bravery and fearlessness.

"No prey seen by this eagle will ever escape."

Tips.SourceString:
“逆焰”的个人定制款，激进的造型与激情的配色，誓要将黑夜点燃。

【燃烧吧！火焰是只属于黑夜的浪漫！】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The "Rebelflame" personalized edition boasts a radical design and passionate colors, vowing to light up the night.

"Burn! Flames are the romance of the night!"

Tips.SourceString:
“逆焰”的个人定制款，苍蓝色的基本涂装搭配大量银饰，每次枪响都伴随着悦耳的铃音，仿佛在诉说一段悠久的传说。

【啊？不需要那种老掉牙的故事，看我来书写新的传说。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Rebelflame custom design combines cobalt tones with silver details, with each gunshot creating a harmonious chime, as if telling a timeless legend.

"Old tales? No thanks. Watch me create a new legend."

Tips.SourceString:
“逆焰”的个人定制款，火狐与红刚玉的融合彰显了主人的热情似火。明形容它是黑夜里跳动的火焰，是比朝霞更早的霞光。

【“来吧，和我一起燃烧腐朽，将黑夜点亮！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized model of the Rebelflame. The red fox and the ruby symbolize the owner's fiery passion. Ming describes it as a flame dancing in the night, glowing before the dawn.

“Let us burn the decay and light up the night!”

Tips.SourceString:
“逆焰”的“沐春节”特供版，枪身组装了类似龙鳞形状的坚甲，一柄青色的尖枪横贯其中，凸显着豪情侠气。

【“进行武艺表演可以吃饭免单？呵，那本女侠就小露两手吧。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special Spring Blessings edition of "Rebelflame" features dragon-scale-like armor on the barrel, with a cyan spear running through it, highlighting its heroic spirit.

"Performing martial arts gets you a free meal? Well then, check this out."

Tips.SourceString:
“逆焰”的贵族晚宴定制款枪械，以酒瓶和红宝石作为设计元素，锋利而流畅的线条彰显了其主人洒脱的性格。

【“哈哈，既然奉我为座上宾，那今晚岂不是能开怀畅饮？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized version of the Rebelflame for noble banquets, featuring wine bottle and ruby design elements. Its sleek, sharp lines reflect the free-spirited nature of its owner.

"If I am the guest of honor, then tonight calls for endless celebration!"

Tips.SourceString: “逆焰”的校园日演出定制款，以古老传说中的神异为涂装，让持握者能够获得澎拜的热血和无尽的力量。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Campus Open Day edition of the Rebelflame is adorned with mythical elements from ancient legends, its wielder surging passion and boundless strength.

Tips.SourceString:
“逆焰”的私人定制款，其身状若奔雷，电光如龙飞腾其间。它的枪响同其主人的名号一样响亮，据说仅鸣一声，即可如雷霆一般撼动江湖，响彻乾坤。

【历史悠久的剪刀手迎新故事会，如今已然成了武侠专场，听客们来自五湖四海。作为突击小队副队的主讲人但凡谈及队长的事迹，便能口若悬河。
然而在某次讲述中，他讲述了数十遍的荒原奔雷记却遭到了一位小听客的打断，对方破天荒地提出了想听听“苍雷潜龙”与罪犯们斗智斗勇的故事。
正当他准备开口作答时，一道战衣飘扬的身影飒沓而来。
“准、准备作战？现在？是什么任务啊，队长？”
“简而言之，就是与罪犯们斗智斗勇！”
顺走一包薯片后，那个身影同时向小听客挥手邀请。
“百闻不如一见！今天，让你看看现场！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized model of the Rebelflame, with a thunderbolt-shaped barrel through which electricity surges like a dragon. Its gunshot is as loud as its owner's reputation. Rumor has it that a single shot from this weapon shakes the land like thunder, echoing through the world.

The Scissors' long-standing tradition of welcoming newcomers with stories has evolved into a martial arts showcase, drawing listeners from all over. As the vice-captain and speaker for the assault team, he eagerly shares tales of the captain's exploits.
During one session, while recounting the Wasteland Thunder story for the 50th time, a young listener unexpectedly interrupts, requesting to hear the adventures of the Thunderous Dragon outsmarting criminals.
Just as he prepares to answer, a figure in a battle suit makes a dramatic entrance.
“P-Prepare for combat? Now? What's the mission, Captain?”
“Simply put, it's a battle of wits against criminals!”
After grabbing a bag of chips, the figure waves to the young listener.
“Seeing is believing! Today, you'll witness it firsthand!”

Tips.SourceString: 短突击步枪，在拥有较高稳定性的同时，其精准性也十分出众。配备1.25倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: Short assault rifle with high stability and outstanding accuracy. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “浪潮”系列涂装，以蓝色色块组合模拟海浪的造型，虽无潮声，却也沁人心脾。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Tidal Wave" series is composed of a series of blue modules meant to imitate the shape of a wave. It may lack the sound of the sea, but it remains a delight.

Tips.SourceString: “霓虹”系列涂装，SCIS-08定制款，叛逆不羁的色彩搭配，受到剪刀手阵营的青睐。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Neon" SCIS-08 custom edition showcases The Scissors' bold rebellion with its edgy color scheme.

Tips.SourceString: “紫金”系列涂装，别出心裁的紫金撞色搭配给予枪身别样的质感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Violet Gold series features a unique blend of purple and gold, giving the weapon a distinct texture.

Tips.SourceString: “迷彩”系列涂装，枪身上多样的色彩融合，很好地达到了融入自然环境的效果。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Camo" series. The firearm features perfect textures to blend seamlessly into natural environments.

Tips.SourceString: “信念”系列涂装，黑底，配上剪刀手徽记与涂鸦，肃杀中彰显出持有者坚定的意志。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Faith" series features a black base with The Scissors emblem, showcasing the holder's unwavering resolve.

Tips.SourceString: “魅紫”系列涂装，以明亮的紫色填充枪身，赋予枪身独特的神秘感。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Arcane Purple" series, this firearm, adorned in bright purple, exudes a sense of mystery.

Tips.SourceString: “交错线”系列涂装，以暗色为敌，用交叉，叠加的线条作为主要的图形，在视觉上具有一定的迷惑性。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Crisscross series features a dark base with intersecting lines, creating a dazzling display on the battlefield.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“浪人”系列枪械造型，神秘迷幻的紫色枪身中仿佛有浪花跃动，抚慰着每一位浪人的心。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Ronin series produced by Quadrant Foundries features waves dancing on a mysterious and psychedelic purple background, soothing the hearts of many wandering warriors.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“夏日海滩”系列枪械造型，完美地将不同种类的海滩元素附着于枪身之上，宁静时刻，甚至能听见海潮的回响。
Tips.LocalizedString: Manufactured by Quadrant Foundries, the Summer Beach series of firearms perfectly blends various beach elements onto the barrel. In tranquil moments, you might even hear the echo of the waves.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“Q版世界”系列枪械造型，将定制者的Q版三视图融入视觉设计中，为枪身赋予轻松气息的同时，更好地满足了客制化需求。
Tips.LocalizedString: Manufactured by Quadrant Foundries, the "Chibi World" series of firearms features custom Chibi-style art, adding a relaxed vibe to the barrel while fulfilling customization needs.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“纸牌屋”系列枪械造型，枪身中央有着客户定制的艺术头像，四周环绕的卡牌装饰，俏皮中略带几分神秘。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series from Corridor Artisans gained its intriguing reputation from the client's meticulous requirements for an avatar encircled by decorative card elements.

Tips.SourceString: “龙腾虎跃”系列涂装，以黄白二色凸显喜庆之感，刻画舞狮的剪刀手队员们跃然而上，凸显龙马精神。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Lion Dance" series features a festive yellow and white design, depicting Scissors members performing lion dances, embodying spirit and vitality.

Tips.SourceString: “飞鸟”系列主题涂装，生动描绘了多种鸟类动物的活泼生态，仔细观察似乎还被涂画上了使用者的个性符号。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Aviary" series imitates a lively avian ecosystem and subtly includes the user's personal symbol.

Tips.SourceString: “禁区”系列涂装，为适应科斯迷特沙漠环境而进行再配色的制式涂装，有着良好的隐蔽性。其上的警示图标也是准入该地区的“凭证”之一。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Forbidden" series showcases a standard paint job adapted for improved concealment in Cosmite's environment. Its pronounced warning label is as good as any permit.

Tips.SourceString:
“影袭”的定制款。流金镶边犹如夕阳辉光，茜红枪身仿佛日暮红云。人们曾期盼着如此华丽灿烂的未来。

【“晚霞虽美，却躲不过一场洗净天空的风暴。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The customized Shadow Assault features gilded edges like the setting sun and a crimson barrel resembling twilight clouds, symbolizing the splendid future people once hoped to see.

“Beautiful as the evening glow may be, it cannot escape the storm that cleanses the sky.”

Tips.SourceString:
象限工造出品，“影袭”的生化主题款式。虽然卡丘世界并不再拥有“生化”的概念，但其于古地球的影响力以及背后的警示意义，至今依旧存在。

【生化武器不过是无数底线中的一道，而战争是没有底线的。
残酷的时代必将落幕，那些不被限制的力量，终将成为人类的绝望。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Biochemistry-themed version of the Shadow Assault by Quadrant Foundries. While the concept of 'biochemistry' no longer exists in Strinova, its influence on ancient Earth and the warning it carries still endure.

"Biochemical weapons are just one of many boundaries, but war knows no limits. Cruel times will eventually end. Unchecked power will ultimately become humanity's despair."

Tips.SourceString:
以“影袭”为基础，加入了赛博朋克风格改造的款式。暗蓝色的枪身流溢紫光，宛如风雨欲来，云层间隐现雷霆。

【“决不害怕每个刹那”——
永恒之声如此高歌。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A cyberpunk-style Shadow Assault model. Its dark blue barrel emits a violet glow, resembling an impending storm with thunder and lightning concealed among the clouds.

"Fear not every moment."
- The Song of Eternity

Tips.SourceString:
“影袭”的定制款，欧泊风格的蓝白配色极具伪装性，但实际上出自象限工造之手。

【不断摒弃虚妄的过程，让我得以成为现在的我。
因此，无需多言，只需求索。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A custom version of Shadow Assault by Quadrant Foundries, cleverly cloaked in P.U.S. blue and white for stealth.

“By shedding illusions, I've become my true self.”

Tips.SourceString:
“影袭”的个人定制款，精妙的伪装适用于暗中出击的场合使用，充分体现了以静制动的特别含义。

【“嘿，树叶在说话？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized version of the Shadow Assault featuring clever camouflage suitable for convert operations, embodying the concept of patience.

【“Hey, are the leaves talking?”】

Tips.SourceString:
影袭的节日特供版，枪身风格沿用了拉薇最喜欢的尖锐和流线型设计，喷出的青色能量流似乎也形成了利齿的样子十分威风。

【“快跑吧，不然你就就要被吃掉了……台词是这么念的吧？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The festival edition of Shadow Assault features Lawine's favorite sharp and sleek design. The cyan energy it emits takes the form of imposing fangs.

"Run before I devour you!... That's how the line goes, right?"

Tips.SourceString:
金树音乐会发放的奖品之一，拉薇委托令将其改造为了一把值得纪念的枪械，时不时地她就会拿出来这把枪呢喃着什么……

【“夕阳……真美啊。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A prize from Lux Concerta, modified by Reiichi at Lawine's request into a commemorative firearm. Every now and then, she can be found brandishing the firearm and muttering something.

“The setting sun... It's glorious.”

Tips.SourceString:
“影袭”的个人定制款。蓝宝石恰到好处地嵌在镂空枪身里，正如剪刀手的此次的计划一般天衣无缝。

【”时间开始了——”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized Shadow Assault model, featuring a sapphire seamlessly set into the hollow barrel, mirroring The Scissors' flawless plan.

"It's time!"

Tips.SourceString:
“影袭”的客制化枪械外观，一柄利刃隐于深邃如夜的枪身之上，只在最重要的时候才会展露猩红如珠的锋芒，一如在咖啡厅内收敛锋芒、伺机而动的拉薇。

【“店内出现了身份不明的人……为了你的安全，必要的时候我会采取行动。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The customized Shadow Assault features a concealed blade on its night-black frame, revealing its ruby-red edge only at critical moments, much like Lawine, who waits discreetly in the café, poised to act.

"There are unidentified people in the café... For your safety, I'll step in if necessary."

Tips.SourceString:
“影袭”的荒野行动调色版，为了配合隐匿的需求，令为这把枪进行了涂装。当人与枪与大地融为一体时，稗草、乌麦还有更多拉薇叫不出名字的植物……它们随着她的匍匐前进，微微摇晃。
【野草也有属于野草的格调，它们的根往往扎得很深，而且，永不屈服。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A camouflage edition of the Shadow Assault, painted by Reiichi to aid stealth in the wilderness. As Lawine and her gun blend in with the earth, ryegrass, wild oats, and countless plants she cannot name sway as she crawls forward.

"Even wild grass has its own charm. Its roots are deep and unyielding."

Tips.SourceString:
“影袭”的地下酒吧特供版，在侧面装饰了雕刻精巧的兰花。世人印象中的兰花柔软芬芳，但拉薇却认为其亦有高洁坚贞之志。
【“这些花如果有香味，应该也是冷冷的吧。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special underground bar edition of the Shadow Assault, decorated with intricately carved orchids. While most people consider orchids fragile and fragrant, Lawine believes they represent purity and steadfastness.

"If they had a scent, it’d be a cold one."

Tips.SourceString:
“影袭”的私人定制款，将梅花与古风的要素融入其中，继承了武将的勇猛与梅花的傲骨，即使在最艰难的战事中，也将同自己的主人一马当先，摧锋陷阵。

【雪夜月黑，冬天的沙场格外寒冷。
身后的将士们相继倒下，唯独武将一人还在与风雪抗争。突如其来的大雪葬送了一切，也许连那剪冬梅也被淹没了。
作为统帅，武将不可折服，她还要兑现折梅相见的约定。正如这把枪的名字“一剪梅”，再冷酷的冬雪下，梅花都将凌寒独立。
而在寒冬过后，归乡的初春之日也就不远了吧。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A personalized Shadow Assault model, featuring plum blossom motifs and classical elements. It embodies legendary heroism and enduring pride, ready to confront any battle alongside its master.

"As snow falls in the dark, the battlefield is wrapped in a frigid embrace. As comrades fell, a lone general stood firm against the gale and snow. The sudden storm buried everything—including, perhaps, the plum tree.
Yet, as a leader, the general remained unyielding, determined to keep her promise beneath the plum blossom.
Surely, once winter passes, the arrival of spring is not far behind."

Tips.SourceString: 精确射手步枪，完美解决威力与射程的两难问题，可有效压制中远距离的敌方单位。配备1.5倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: Balancing power and range perfectly, the marksman rifle excels at suppressing mid-to-long-distance targets. Comes equipped with a 1.5x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “秘纹”系列涂装，靛蓝色块搭配橙色纹路，加之独具特色的图形标志，曾一度引领涂装审美的浪潮。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Mystic Mark series's eye-catching indigo blocks laced with beautiful orange lines once found considerable favor in the community.

Tips.SourceString: “多维”系列涂装，以卡拉彼丘图案为设计锚点，简约却不简单的图形中，流溢着别样的设计魅力。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Multiverse" series features a Strinova-inspired design. Its simple yet intricate patterns exude a unique charm.

Tips.SourceString: “热情”系列涂装，URB-00定制款，艳丽乖张的色彩彰显最为新潮的理念，深受乌尔比诺成员们的喜爱。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Ardor" series, URB-00 custom edition, features vibrant, edgy colors that reflect the latest trends, and is a favorite among Urbino members.

Tips.SourceString: “错觉”系列涂装，以蓝色调为主，混合扭曲的色彩看似在流动一般，表现出复杂动态的变形之美。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Illusion" series, this firearm's blue highlights twist and turn, as if melting into the design.

Tips.SourceString: “嵌合”系列涂装，深浓浅淡，错落有致的橙色马赛克涂装，带来独特而充满视觉效果的艺术感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Chimera" series features an elegant orange mosaic design with deep and light tones, creating an artistic look.

Tips.SourceString: “棱镜”系列涂装，不同深浅的紫红色调，仿佛在棱镜碎片中折射，显现出万花筒一般的美感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Prisma" series uses refractive fragmentation, with artistic purple shades evoking a kaleidoscopic feeling.

Tips.SourceString: “蜂巢”系列涂装，充满科技感的蓝紫色，赋以六角形的边界图案，体现出严谨而精密的科学之美。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Hive" series features a tech-inspired blue and purple theme with hexagrammic border designs, showcasing the beauty of precise and meticulous science.

Tips.SourceString: “交错线”系列涂装，以暗色为敌，用交叉，叠加的线条作为主要的图形，在视觉上具有一定的迷惑性。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Crisscross series features a dark base with intersecting lines, creating a dazzling display on the battlefield.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“占星”系列枪械造型，神秘与潮流的结合，长廊绘制所内画师们的呕心沥血之作。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Astrologist" series by Corridor Artisans is a careful blend of mystery and trend, said to be the painstaking work of their top artist.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“漫画之星”系列枪械造型，于枪身中央增添了客户定制的艺术头像，配以精心搭配的色块设计，更好地还原了客户们的个性化需求。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Manga Star" series by Corridor Artisans showcases a customized avatar at the center of the gun, enhanced with thoughtfully designed color blocks to accentuate clients' unique preferences.

Tips.SourceString: “纸牌屋”系列涂装，以绿心桃形作为主体，充满活力的乌尔比诺成员今天也在为了自由和艺术而战。
Tips.LocalizedString: A model in the "House of Cards" series, coveted by Urbino fighters who favor bringing this artistic weapon into battle.

Tips.SourceString: “暗金浪涌”系列主题涂装，由偏光实验室推出的枪械涂装，主打暗金色调，在保证酷炫拉风的同时，也颇具金属般的沉稳感与力量感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Golden Surge" series, launched by Polaris Labs, features a dark gold pattern that combines a cool, flashy look with a powerful sense of metallic stability.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“幻海”系列枪械造型，将海洋元素融入枪身之内，又附以如梦似幻的渐变配色，大大加强了枪械的整体艺术感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Mystic Ocean" series by Corridor Artisans beautifully blends oceanic elements with dreamlike gradient colors, enhancing the firearm's artistic appeal.

Tips.SourceString:
“彩绘”的概念客制型号，其艺术设计风格源自于玛德蕾娜的个人审美，额外增添了她喜爱的兔兔元素。

【最后一只兔兔驾驶着火箭飞往了宇宙的深处。于是，我们依稀可见远方群星浩渺，一颗火种冉冉升入未知的浩瀚，为兔兔文明的终结立下落幕的丰碑。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized concept model of the Chroma. Inspired by Maddalena's aesthetics, it features her favorite bunny-themed elements.

"The last bunny rides a rocket into the depths of space.
In the vastness of stars, a spark rises into the unknown, marking the end of the glorious bunny civilization."

Tips.SourceString:
“彩绘”的创意客制型号，水枪的造型活泼可爱。但当它开火之时，子弹就如同无情的浪涛席卷而来。

【大海有时风平浪静，有时吞没一切。
自由亦如此，追寻它的过程中，可能带来幸福，也可能带来毁灭。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Chroma custom model features a cute water gun design. When it fires, the bullets surge like raging waves.

"The sea can be calm, yet it can also swallow everything. Freedom is similar; pursuing it might bring happiness or destruction."

Tips.SourceString:
“彩绘”的个人定制款，适用于野外场合的作战，枪身的装饰根据玛德蕾娜在野外写生时遇到的动物所描绘，可爱的表情让人忍俊不禁。

【“这是我的动物伙伴，和它打个招呼吧？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized Chroma model, ideal for outdoor combat. The gun's decor is inspired by animals Maddelena sketched in the wild, with cute expressions sure to bring a smile.

"This is my little companion. Why not say hello?"

Tips.SourceString:
“彩绘”的定制款枪械，在满足太空流线的基础美感上添加了象征宇宙星云的粉紫色能量束，在为枪械提供澎湃动力的同时，也是非常不错的荧光剂，能让她的作品在黑暗的宇宙熠熠生辉。

【“就让我把你点缀得更加灿烂一点，如何？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The customized Chroma features a sleek space design enhanced with pink-purple energy beams symbolizing cosmic nebulae. These beams not only provide powerful energy for the weapon but also serve as excellent illuminators, making her creation shine brightly in the dark void of space.

“Let me adorn you to make you even more radiant.”

Tips.SourceString:
“彩绘”的轻量化改装，在设计时融入了对旋律这一概念的印象化处理，当拿起它的时候，枪声总会成为一种动感的音符。

【“是时候嗨起来了，朋友们！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
This lightweight Chroma modification captures the essence of melody in its design. When fired, each shot resonates like a dynamic note.

"It's time to dance, my friends!"

Tips.SourceString:
音乐会后玛德蕾娜通过音乐会得到的灵感而制成的装备，拉机柄上甚至配备了琴弦，等待随时奏响乐章。

【“这次的演奏，你听到了吗？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Maddelena's post-concert creation, crafted from newfound inspiration. The loading handle is equipped with strings, ready to strike a chord anytime.

"Did this performance reach your ears?"

Tips.SourceString:
“彩绘”的艺术特化型号，以古典浪漫的风格设计而成，轻扣枪身的铃鼓，即可奏响一曲美妙的舞曲。

【“别害怕我的子弹嘛，我只是想邀请你一起演奏铃鼓而已~”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The classically designed romantic Chroma model features a tambourine on its body, ready to play a delightful dance tune.

“Don't fear my bullets; I'm just inviting you to join in a tambourine performance.”

Tips.SourceString:
“彩绘”的客制化设计款，枪身以鲜亮的嫩绿为主色调，点缀有可爱的卡通角色，融入玛德蕾娜天真浪漫的奇思与童趣。

【“真是奇妙，小的时候想快点长大，长大了却又想变回小孩子。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A custom Chroma design, featuring a bright green body adorned with cute cartoon characters, capturing Maddelena's whimsical and childlike imagination.

"It's funny, isn't it? When we're young, we couldn't wait to grow up, but as adults, we wish to be young again."

Tips.SourceString:
“彩绘”的奇趣游乐园定制款涂装，水豚驾驶着橡木海盗船，在森林中不断穿行，是玛德蕾娜在射气球摊位中拿到的奖品。

【“诶？看起来软乎乎的水豚，一旦被激起胜负欲也挺有脾气的嘛！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Chroma Wonder Park edition features a capybara at the helm of an oak pirate ship, sailing through the forest. It was Madrena's prize from a balloon shooting game.

"Huh? This cuddly capybara has quite a competitive streak when it's determined to win!"

Tips.SourceString: 画家玛德蕾娜的爱枪“彩绘”摇身一变，成了一把造型复古、充满蒸汽趣味的产品。是时候与怪盗正面对决了！不过，要切记探案时间极为紧迫，要记得随时查看时钟哦。
Tips.LocalizedString: Maddelena's beloved Chroma has transformed into a retro steampunk marvel. It's time to face the phantom thieves! Remember, time is tight, so keep an eye on the clock!

Tips.SourceString: 画家玛德蕾娜的爱枪“彩绘”摇身一变，成了一把造型复古、充满蒸汽趣味的产品。是时候与怪盗正面对决了！不过，要切记探案时间极为紧迫，要记得随时查看时钟哦。
Tips.LocalizedString: Maddelena's beloved Chroma has transformed into a retro steampunk marvel. It's time to face the phantom thieves! Remember, time is tight, so keep an eye on the clock!

Tips.SourceString: 自动步枪，因使用全威力步枪弹，而具有较强的战斗性，能适应全天候作战。配备1.5倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: This automatic rifle uses high-powered rounds for superior combat effectiveness, perfect for all-weather operations. Equipped with a 1.5x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “深湖”系列涂装，在保持整体青色基调的情况下进行了少许明暗调整，成品效果内敛且深沉。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the Deep Lake series. Streaks of light and dark on resplendent cyan make for a restrained and brooding design.

Tips.SourceString: “彩斑”系列涂装，以复数颜料色带涂抹而成，看似随性，却有艺术的气息喷薄而出。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the Colorburst series. Painted with streaks of different pigments. This firearm has a casual vibe, but it's overflowing with artistic flair.

Tips.SourceString: “警戒”系列涂装，PUS-04定制款，鲜明醒目，欧泊阵营中随处可见。
Tips.LocalizedString: The popular P.U.S-04 Vigilance adds a bright and distinctive finish to the P.U.S arsenal.

Tips.SourceString: “雷火”系列涂装，橙灰交错，复古的同时融入了潮流元素。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Thunderfire series blends contemporary sleekness with retro orange-gray elements.

Tips.SourceString: “碎梦”系列涂装，由不规则蓝色色块堆叠而成，图案中偶尔掺杂少量黄色碎片，给人以强烈的破碎感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Dreambreaker series combines patchy blues with occasional yellow fragments for a striking, shattered effect.

Tips.SourceString: “炫彩”系列涂装，由大量六边形色块重叠而成，斑斓的色彩效果甚至令人有种火力增强的错觉。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Vivid" series. Made up of a variety of overlapping hexagonal color blocks, this firearm's streams of color give off the illusion of added firepower.

Tips.SourceString: “冲浪”系列涂装，使用简约的色块勾勒出了沙滩与海浪的景象，拿在手上仿佛也能乘上海浪勇往直前。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Wave Surfer" series evokes beachside wave imagery with its minimalist blockish color design.

Tips.SourceString:
“审判官”的执事装特殊定制枪械，干练流畅的线条加上简约实用的小装置，全能执事在任何时候，都能带您进入微醺时刻。

【“偶尔喝醉也没关系，我会在这里照顾您的。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Inspector butler edition combines clean design with functional add-ons, providing a classy companion for when you're in the mood for a gentle buzz.

"Feel free to indulge; I've got your back."

Tips.SourceString:
“审判官”的贵族晚宴定制版枪械，设计繁复而优雅，以他出席宴会时常佩戴的银色假面为装饰。

【“假面舞会也是晚宴的重要一环，理应在礼仪上得到重视。”】
Tips.LocalizedString: A custom Judge model crafted for noble banquets, elegantly designed with intricate details and featuring the silver mask commonly worn at these events.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“主角之星”系列枪械造型，为客户特殊定制个性化形象并将其融入枪身设计中，堪称定制枪械设计的典范。
Tips.LocalizedString: Protagonist Star series produced by Polaris Labs, a classic example of stylistic design incorporating the client's very specific demands.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“夏日派对”系列枪械造型，整体洋溢着轻松活跃的氛围，在战斗中甚至能起到鼓舞士气的作用。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Summer Party series by Polaris Labs exudes a relaxed and lively vibe. This firearm can boost morale even in the heat of battle.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“纸牌屋”系列枪械造型，枪身中央有着客户定制的艺术头像，四周环绕的卡牌装饰，俏皮中略带几分神秘。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series from Corridor Artisans gained its intriguing reputation from the client's meticulous requirements for an avatar encircled by decorative card elements.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“招财猫”系列枪械造型，以象征着开运的招财猫为设计锚点，表达了设计者对客户们的美好祝福。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Maneki-Neko" series by Polaris Labs uses the symbol of the good fortune cat as its design anchor, expressing the creator's best wishes for clients.

Tips.SourceString: “飞鸟”系列主题涂装，生动描绘了多种鸟类动物的活泼生态，仔细观察似乎还被涂画上了使用者的个性符号。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Aviary" series imitates a lively avian ecosystem and subtly includes the user's personal symbol.

Tips.SourceString:
“审判官”的概念定制款，以赛博朋克为主题，搭配以时尚的配色，绚丽之余，又引人反思。

【霓虹尚未褪去旧色，曙光依旧风雨飘摇。
往日繁华仍在，可那钢铁丛林之下，文明的灯火却再无微光泛起。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The custom Judge concept features a cyberpunk theme with a stylish color palette. It's vibrant yet thought-provoking.

"Neon lights haven't yet faded, and dawn remains uncertain. Though the glory of the past remains, under the clashing of steel, the light of civilization no longer shines."

Tips.SourceString:
“审判官”的个人定制款，夕日之下，双鹤齐飞，送别归人。

【鹤翼，会带你归去。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Judge custom edition features dual cranes soaring at sunset, bidding farewell to travelers.

"The wings of the crane will take you back."

Tips.SourceString:
以“审判官”为原型设计的新式枪械，内部暗藏的巴布洛晶体电路使得枪械性能发生了翻天覆地的变化。

【何以裁断过去？
否定陈旧的，终结滞后的，毁灭迂腐的。
而后……接受新生的。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A new model based on the Judge. The hidden Bablo Crystal inside has vastly improved the firearm's performance.

"Why dwell on the past?
Reject the old. Eliminate the stagnant. Destroy the obsolete.
And then... Embrace the new."

Tips.SourceString:
“审判官“的个人定制款，适合水边使用。气垫船造型的枪管部位能够稳定枪身，提升枪械性能。

【思考时间已经太久，该投身战场了。
距离我的目标，还有很遥远的一段航程。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The custom Judge design is ideal for use by the water. The hovercraft-shaped barrel stabilizes the gun, enhancing its performance.

"I've spent too long thinking; it's time to enter the battlefield. There's still a long journey to my objective."

Tips.SourceString:
审判官的特别纪念款，这涂装是信第二次获得荒野冬日挑战赛竞速赛冠军的奖品，该涂装还原了信当时驾驶的雪地摩托造型，每当拿起它，信就想起了当日驰骋雪原，放空自己的快乐。

【“呵……让我们贴地飞行吧，伙伴。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special edition Judge model featuring a paint job awarded to Nobunaga for winning the Wilderness Winter Challenge for the second time. The design mirrors the snowmobile he rode during the race. Whenever Nobunaga holds it, he remembers the joy of racing through the snowfields.

"Heh... Let's ride, my friend."

Tips.SourceString:
令的尝试改造装备之一。外观上融入了舞台射灯与动感跑车的元素，特殊的打击音效满足了令对力与速双重美感的追求。

【“每一个街头鼓手，都有站上至高舞台的梦想。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
One of the pieces of equipment Reiichi has modified. Featuring elements of stage lights and performance cars, it comes with special sound effects that satisfy Reiichi's pursuit of power and speed.

"Every street drummer dreams of performing on the grandest stage."

Tips.SourceString:
“审判官”的特别改装款，将棋子融入枪械设计，是为西洋棋表演赛专门定制的专属款式。黑金色的搭配干练帅气，信非常喜欢。

【“我一定会比你多想一步。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A modified version of the "Judge" that incorporates chess pieces into the design, exclusively customized for chess show matches. Its sleek black and gold design makes it one of Nobunaga's favorites.

"I'll always be one move ahead of you."

Tips.SourceString:
“审判官”的艺术特化型号，使用了信最惯用的蓝色涂装，枪身中贯入一柄利剑，虽锋芒内敛，但始终端正如一。

【“只有坚守信念，我才不会踏入歧途。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A modified version of the Judge that incorporates chess pieces into the design, exclusively customized for chess show matches. Its sleek black and gold design makes it one of Nobunaga's favorites.

"I will also think one move ahead of you."

Tips.SourceString: 通用机枪，在古地球的某次人类大规模战争时期，曾是经典的收割型武器，其威力与性能可见一斑。配备1.25倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: Known for its remarkable power and performance, this general-purpose machine gun was a classic sweeper weapon from old Earth's large-scale wars. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “多维”系列涂装，以卡拉彼丘图案为设计锚点，简约却不简单的图形中，流溢着别样的设计魅力。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Multiverse" series features a Strinova-inspired design. Its simple yet intricate patterns exude a unique charm.

Tips.SourceString: “热情”系列涂装，URB-00定制款，艳丽乖张的色彩彰显最为新潮的理念，深受乌尔比诺成员们的喜爱。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Ardor" series, URB-00 custom edition, features vibrant, edgy colors that reflect the latest trends, and is a favorite among Urbino members.

Tips.SourceString: “错觉”系列涂装，以蓝色调为主，混合扭曲的色彩看似在流动一般，表现出复杂动态的变形之美。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Illusion" series, this firearm's blue highlights twist and turn, as if melting into the design.

Tips.SourceString: “嵌合”系列涂装，深浓浅淡，错落有致的橙色马赛克涂装，带来独特而充满视觉效果的艺术感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Chimera" series features an elegant orange mosaic design with deep and light tones, creating an artistic look.

Tips.SourceString: “棱镜”系列涂装，不同深浅的紫红色调，仿佛在棱镜碎片中折射，显现出万花筒一般的美感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Prisma" series uses refractive fragmentation, with artistic purple shades evoking a kaleidoscopic feeling.

Tips.SourceString: “蜂巢”系列涂装，充满科技感的蓝紫色，赋以六角形的边界图案，体现出严谨而精密的科学之美。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Hive" series features a tech-inspired blue and purple theme with hexagrammic border designs, showcasing the beauty of precise and meticulous science.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“占星”系列枪械造型，神秘与潮流的结合，长廊绘制所内画师们的呕心沥血之作。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Astrologist" series by Corridor Artisans is a careful blend of mystery and trend, said to be the painstaking work of their top artist.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“漫画之星”系列枪械造型，于枪身中央增添了客户定制的艺术头像，配以精心搭配的色块设计，更好地还原了客户们的个性化需求。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Manga Star" series by Corridor Artisans showcases a customized avatar at the center of the gun, enhanced with thoughtfully designed color blocks to accentuate clients' unique preferences.

Tips.SourceString: “纸牌屋”系列涂装，以绿心桃形作为主体，充满活力的乌尔比诺成员今天也在为了自由和艺术而战。
Tips.LocalizedString: A model in the "House of Cards" series, coveted by Urbino fighters who favor bringing this artistic weapon into battle.

Tips.SourceString: “暗金浪涌”系列主题涂装，由偏光实验室推出的枪械涂装，主打暗金色调，在保证酷炫拉风的同时，也颇具金属般的沉稳感与力量感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Golden Surge" series, launched by Polaris Labs, features a dark gold pattern that combines a cool, flashy look with a powerful sense of metallic stability.

Tips.SourceString: “禁区”系列涂装，为适应科斯迷特沙漠环境而进行再配色的制式涂装，有着良好的隐蔽性。其上的警示图标也是准入该地区的“凭证”之一。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Forbidden" series showcases a standard paint job adapted for improved concealment in Cosmite's environment. Its pronounced warning label is as good as any permit.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“幻海”系列枪械造型，将海洋元素融入枪身之内，又附以如梦似幻的渐变配色，大大加强了枪械的整体艺术感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Mystic Ocean" series by Corridor Artisans beautifully blends oceanic elements with dreamlike gradient colors, enhancing the firearm's artistic appeal.

Tips.SourceString:
“卫冕”的艺术定制款，其图纸由奥黛丽亲手设计，共计融入四种不同的乐器要素，每一串音符中各自不同的音色，都演奏着同一首旋律。

【它是钢琴，是萨克斯，是古早的黑胶唱片孤独地旋转，记录过去的昏黄时光。
我不知道这把枪见证过什么样的时代兴衰，但枪鸣的那一刻，过去的一切，昭然若揭。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The custom Champion design by Audrey incorporates four unique musical elements. Each string of notes plays the same melody with distinct tones.

"It's a piano, a saxophone, an old vinyl spinning in solitude, capturing the faded memories of the past. I don't know what eras this gun has witnessed, but the moment it fires, the past becomes crystal clear."

Tips.SourceString:
“卫冕”的艺术定制款，设计者以古地球的地方民俗文化为核心设计锚点，淋漓尽致地展现出了一个意境深远的文化风貌。

【丰年不知是梦，寻狐中稻荷，或求幻影，或求虚。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The artistic custom version of "Champion" is inspired by old Earth's local folklore, vividly showcasing a deeply cultural aesthetic.

“In ignorance of bountiful years true,
Chasing the fox god, a myth in view,
Finding none but illusions and emptiness.”

Tips.SourceString:
“卫冕”的艺术定制款，以古雅的琴弦为饰。古典风情的美感中，暗藏着科技的结晶。

【云想衣裳花想容，春风拂槛露华浓。
若非群玉山头见，会向瑶台月下逢。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized artistic version of the Champion, adorned with strings of the Guqin, concealing the pinnacle of technology under the classic design.

"In drifting clouds, her garments I find; in blossoms, her visage so fair.
She shines by the balustrade, caressed by the dew-laden air.
Should Jade Mountain's peak hold her not in view.
Then beneath the moon, on gemstone terrace, she'll appear anew."

Tips.SourceString:
“尊享服务”的配套枪械客制化外观，纷繁复杂的枪身装饰和优雅的弹鼓都证明着它作为火力艺术品的价值有多高。

【“今天的下午茶不光有沁人的茶水和可口的点心，还有着管饱的子弹。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The customized "Manor's Grace" model's intricate design proves that high art can be just as deadly.

"Today's menu includes refreshing tea, delicious snacks, and a hearty supply of bullets."

Tips.SourceString:
“卫冕”的个人定制化型号，在原有的枪械基础上加强了对光线的敏感性，无论是摄影还是射人，它都能得到完美的发挥。

【“这一瞬间确实值得记录，你难道不这么认为吗？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized version of the Champion featuring enhanced sensitivity to light. Whether for photography or firing bullets, it performs in perfection.

"This moment is worth capturing, don't you think?"

Tips.SourceString:
“卫冕”的舞会特供版，由格罗夫工匠打造，琉璃般的光泽彰显华贵，泉水般的温润亦能滋养主人，在贵族云集的舞会上，它绝对配得上其主人的品味与身姿。

【“让我们一同成为舞会的焦点吧。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Crafted by Grove artisans, the Champion gala edition dazzles with a glass-like sheen and refreshing elegance. Perfect for making a statement at noble gatherings.

"Let's steal the spotlight."

Tips.SourceString:
卫冕的“沐春节”特供版，云涌之时，飞龙腾起，寄予了奥黛丽对个人未来的期望。

【“新的一年，也许我会给乌尔比诺带来一点点新的震撼哦。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Spring Blessing Champion model showcases a dragon soaring through the clouds, reflecting Audrey's aspirations for her future.

"In the new year, maybe I'll bring a little surprise to Urbino."

Tips.SourceString:
“卫冕”的个人定制款，幽邃的配色给人以神秘高贵之感，当枪口绽放火焰之时，也是花朵盛开的时间……

【“扣动扳机也是一种艺术的表现。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A personalized Champion model, with a deep and mysterious color scheme that radiates elegance. When the muzzle flashes, it mimics the blossoming of flowers.

"Pulling the trigger is an art form."

Tips.SourceString:
“卫冕”的客制化改造款，用以庆祝格罗夫餐厅顺利开业，贴心地配备了烤肉机及刀叉餐具，使得在战场之上也能品味格罗夫餐厅的招牌牛排。

【“你想尝尝哪一种美味？牛排还是子弹？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The customized Champion model celebrates the grand opening of Grove Restaurant, complete with a grill and cutlery, letting you enjoy Grove's signature steak even on the battlefield.

"What would you like to order? Steak or bullets?"

Tips.SourceString: “卫冕”的学院开放日定制款，按副会长大人的要求设计了涂装，在体现学院精神的同时，也强调着独角兽家族的荣誉。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Campus Open Day edition of the Champion is crafted per the student council vice president's request. It captures the academy's spirit while celebrating the Grove family's honor.

Tips.SourceString:
“卫冕”的私人定制款，高洁无暇的枪身沐浴着格罗夫的胜利与荣光，热烈的火焰流溢其间，仿佛彰显着格罗夫之主的庄严与不屈。

【曾经为了保护家人，稚嫩的少女第一次拿起这把枪走入炮火与硝烟中。
再度拿起这把经过全新升级后的枪械，她紧锁的眉头间多了几份从容与坚定。
那些问题的答案究竟如何？就像过去一样，用子弹来寻找吧。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A personalized Champion model with a pristine barrel, basking in the Grove family's glory and victories. Fervent flames flow through it, symbolizing Lord Grove's indomitable spirit.

To protect her family, the young girl took this gun onto the battlefield. Now, with the newly upgraded weapon in hand, there's composure and determination in her once-furrowed brow. The answers to those questions? As before, seek them through bullets.

Tips.SourceString: 冲锋枪，体积轻巧，可快速连续发射，拥有较同类枪械更出色的精确度，配备1.25倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: A light-weight submachine gun with an unusually high rate of fire and precision compared to most other weapons in its class. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “碎梦”系列涂装，由不规则蓝色色块堆叠而成，图案中偶尔掺杂少量黄色碎片，给人以强烈的破碎感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Dreambreaker series combines patchy blues with occasional yellow fragments for a striking, shattered effect.

Tips.SourceString: “警戒”系列涂装，PUS-04定制款，鲜明醒目，欧泊阵营中随处可见。
Tips.LocalizedString: The popular P.U.S-04 Vigilance adds a bright and distinctive finish to the P.U.S arsenal.

Tips.SourceString: “雷火”系列涂装，橙灰交错，复古的同时融入了潮流元素。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Thunderfire series blends contemporary sleekness with retro orange-gray elements.

Tips.SourceString: “彩斑”系列涂装，以复数颜料色带涂抹而成，看似随性，却有艺术的气息喷薄而出。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the Colorburst series. Painted with streaks of different pigments. This firearm has a casual vibe, but it's overflowing with artistic flair.

Tips.SourceString: “落日”系列定制涂装，橙白色的渐变预示着敌人的黑夜将至。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Sunset" series features a tasteful orange-white gradient, symbolizing the coming of twilight.

Tips.SourceString: “炫彩”系列涂装，由大量六边形色块重叠而成，斑斓的色彩效果甚至令人有种火力增强的错觉。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Vivid" series. Made up of a variety of overlapping hexagonal color blocks, this firearm's streams of color give off the illusion of added firepower.

Tips.SourceString: “冲浪”系列涂装，使用简约的色块勾勒出了沙滩与海浪的景象，拿在手上仿佛也能乘上海浪勇往直前。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Wave Surfer" series evokes beachside wave imagery with its minimalist blockish color design.

Tips.SourceString: “交错线”系列涂装，以暗色为敌，用交叉，叠加的线条作为主要的图形，在视觉上具有一定的迷惑性。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Crisscross series features a dark base with intersecting lines, creating a dazzling display on the battlefield.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“主角之星”系列枪械造型，为客户特殊定制个性化形象并将其融入枪身设计中，堪称定制枪械设计的典范。
Tips.LocalizedString: Protagonist Star series produced by Polaris Labs, a classic example of stylistic design incorporating the client's very specific demands.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“夏日派对”系列枪械造型，整体洋溢着轻松活跃的氛围，在战斗中甚至能起到鼓舞士气的作用。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Summer Party series by Polaris Labs exudes a relaxed and lively vibe. This firearm can boost morale even in the heat of battle.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“纸牌屋”系列枪械造型，枪身中央有着客户定制的艺术头像，四周环绕的卡牌装饰，俏皮中略带几分神秘。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series from Corridor Artisans gained its intriguing reputation from the client's meticulous requirements for an avatar encircled by decorative card elements.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“招财猫”系列枪械造型，以象征着开运的招财猫为设计锚点，表达了设计者对客户们的美好祝福。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Maneki-Neko" series by Polaris Labs uses the symbol of the good fortune cat as its design anchor, expressing the creator's best wishes for clients.

Tips.SourceString: “暗金浪涌”系列主题涂装，由偏光实验室推出的枪械涂装，主打暗金色调，在保证酷炫拉风的同时，也颇具金属般的沉稳感与力量感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Golden Surge" series, launched by Polaris Labs, features a dark gold pattern that combines a cool, flashy look with a powerful sense of metallic stability.

Tips.SourceString:
“幻霜”的特别定制款，一改之前枪身冰冷样子，枪身刻画成了代表生命与收获的玉米的样子，任谁看了都会觉得这把枪……显得有些可口美味。

【那个……我知道你很饿，但这东西真的不是用来做爆米花的……】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The custom Beareas model trades its icy look for a corn-themed design symbolizing life and harvest. It's hard not to find it... a bit appetizing.

"Uh... I know you're hungry, but this isn't for making popcorn..."

Tips.SourceString:
“幻霜”的个人定制款。华丽的紫色涂装，萌萌的熊猫头，还有开火时激烈跳动的音浪，都象征着在使用者冰冷外表之下，有一颗满怀热情的内心。

【寡言的少女紧抿双唇，不再多语。枪火间杂的错落音符，代替她奏响欢声。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The personalized Beareas model features a luxurious purple finish, a cute panda face, and a fierce soundwave effect when firing, symbolizing the passionate heart hidden beneath the user’s cold exterior.

"The taciturn girl pursed her lips tightly, letting out no sound. The music dancing with gunfire speaks for her."

Tips.SourceString:
“幻霜”的个人定制款，伊薇特在长达十小时的糖分缺乏后迷迷糊糊地画出了这份设计图。

【这是……手擅自画出来的，并不是因为我想尝试这个新品。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The custom "Beareas" design was hazily sketched by Yvette after a ten-hour sugar crash.

"My hands just... did their thing! Not that I was itching to try the new model or anything."

Tips.SourceString:
“心晶冰锁”的配套枪械客制化外观，纯真脆弱的冰芯被封锁在精细繁杂的金属构造中，发射的子弹似乎也不再灼热，而是彻骨的冰冷。

【“请放心，这发子弹不会打痛你的，但它或许会用另一种方式伤害你。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The customized "Frost Core" model features a delicate ice core encased in intricate metalwork. The bullets it fires are not scorching hot, but bone-chillingly cold.

“Rest assured, this bullet won't hurt you, but it may harm you in another way.”

Tips.SourceString:
幻霜的特别型号，毛绒肩垫和握持感极为舒适的握把能极大缓解冲击力是这个型号的最大特点，当然拿上之后似乎也会特别令人犯困……？

【“不好……要、要睡着了……”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special version of the Beareas with a plush shoulder pad and a comfy grip that greatly reduces recoil. Strangely, it also tends to make users feel sleepy...

"Oh, no... I-I'm going to fall asleep..."

Tips.SourceString:
幻霜的节日特供版本，特殊的涂装为了符合节日气氛而花费了一些心思，似乎是为了演出童话特地设计的，能够喷出彩带特效来增强演出效果的样子。

【“啪嚓……嗯，节日快乐。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
This Beareas festival version showcases patterns that embody the holiday spirit. Designed for fairy tale performances, it can spray streamers to enhance the spectacle.

"Snap... hmm, happy holidays."

Tips.SourceString:
“幻霜”的特别定制版，大胆采用了复古文艺的设计方式，以夜明珠作为灵感素材并镶嵌在武器之上，显得华贵非凡。

【“掌上明珠光熠熠，夜间更是照人迷。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special edition Beareas model, featuring a bold retro-artistic design. Inspired by luminous pearls, it’s set with these gems, giving it an extraordinary elegance.

"The pearl in your hand sparkles, dazzling ever more gloriously in the dark."

Tips.SourceString:
“幻霜”的客制化枪械外观，由枪战游戏主办方进行了迷彩喷涂的处理，借由伊薇特的隐身能力，小巧轻盈的“幻霜”也能在关键时刻予以敌人致命一击。

【“别担心，他们都看不见我，伊薇特能保护好自己。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized version of Beareas, featuring camouflage painting by the host of a shooter game. Thanks to Yvette's stealth abilities, the compact Beareas is capable of delivering deadly strikes.

"Don't worry. They can't see me. I can take care of myself."

Tips.SourceString:
“幻霜”的医用特供版，加入了针筒和液管的要素，实时监测着对手的心跳。
【“也……也对伊薇特敞开心扉吧。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The special medical edition of Beareas features syringe and tube elements, monitoring opponents' heartbeats in real-time.

“Please... open up to me.”

Tips.SourceString:
“幻霜”的贵族晚宴特供版，使用了炫目的鎏金配色，辅以珠宝和钻石的装饰，让人目眩神迷。

【“总觉得踏入宴会厅后，处处都有炫目的光芒闪烁……眼睛都要花啦。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The special edition Beareas for noble banquets, featuring a stunning gilded finish adorned with jewels and diamonds, creating an enchanting allure.

"Stepping into the banquet hall, a dazzling brilliance seems to shine everywhere... it's almost blinding."

Tips.SourceString:
“幻霜”的舞会特供版，除了更加小巧轻盈外，还加入了机械和齿轮的元素，即使和晚礼服搭配也并不突兀。
“虽然要参加舞会，但还是想把菲和枪都带着……不然，伊薇特总觉得缺乏安全感……”至于为什么要携带危险品参加舞会，当事人如是说。

【“间奏结束，该回归舞台啦。”】
【“舞会的聚光灯，只追逐最闪耀之人！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special ball edition of Beareas is more compact and lightweight, with added mechanical and gear elements, seamlessly complementing an evening gown.

“I know I'm going to a ball, but I want to bring Fay and my gun... Otherwise, I may feel insecure...”

Tips.LocalizedString: The "Maneki-Neko" series by Polaris Labs uses the symbol of the good fortune cat as its design anchor, expressing the creator's best wishes for clients.

Tips.SourceString: 格罗夫集团出品，“回味时光”咖啡厅同名主题涂装，依据持有者的喜好进行了个性化设计。不论是难眠的深夜，亦或是悠闲的午后，这杯咖啡都为你带来了一段值得回味的香浓时光。
Tips.LocalizedString: Produced by Grove Enterprises, the "Café Reminiscence" themed design is personalized according to the owner's taste. Whether it's a restless night or a relaxing afternoon, this coffee will bring you a rich and memorable experience.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“璀璨”系列枪械造型，在幽色的瀚宇中点缀璀璨之星，表达了作者对浩瀚星宇的无限畅想。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Luminous" series by Corridor Artisans adorns weapons with brilliant stars in a mysterious cosmos, reflecting the creators' boundless imagination of the universe.

Tips.SourceString: “禁区”系列涂装，为适应科斯迷特沙漠环境而进行再配色的制式涂装，有着良好的隐蔽性。其上的警示图标也是准入该地区的“凭证”之一。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Forbidden" series showcases a standard paint job adapted for improved concealment in Cosmite's environment. Its pronounced warning label is as good as any permit.

Tips.SourceString:
“独舞”的轻量化改装型，除了能作为武器使用，更是淑女出行的必备道具，展现美丽的秘密就在其中。

【“等我一下，我要补个妆顺便收拾一下附近的敌人，不会花多久时间的。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A modified lightweight version of Solo, serving not only as a weapon but also as an essential accessory that holds the secrets of beauty for any lady.

“Be there in a second. I need to touch up my makeup and take care of the nearby enemies. It won't take long.”

Tips.SourceString:
“独舞”的客制化枪械外观，以深色调为主要风格，镶嵌着的特殊晶石在黑夜中也能熠熠生辉，其光辉幽蓝如海，让人捉摸不透。

【“我在想什么？不如……你先猜一猜？这也是了解彼此的一种方式。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The customized Solo model features a dark theme with embedded crystals that gleam brightly even at night, exhibiting a mysterious deep blue shine like the sea.

"Wondering what I'm thinking? Why not... take a guess? It's a way to get to know each other."

Tips.SourceString:
“独舞”的地下酒吧特供版，很显然，这一支是属于孔雀的舞步。
【“孔雀的尾羽？不是哦，这些是我在盯着你的眼睛。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special underground bar edition of Solo. This is obviously the dance of a peacock.

"Peacock tail feathers? No, these are my eyes watching you."

Tips.SourceString:
“独舞”的客制化改造款，枪身主体的绯红火腿，加以齐全的配菜与调料，似乎制作出最正宗的伊比利亚风味也不在话下。如此美味的外表或许会让敌人掉以轻心。

【“小心，不要落入美味迷人的陷阱哦~”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized version of Solo featuring crimson jamón ibérico. With the right condiments, it could almost capture an authentic Iberian flavor. Such a delicious appearance might just make enemies drop their guard.

“Careful. Don't fall for this deliciously charming trap.”

Tips.SourceString:
“独舞”的泳池派对限定版。在装饰材料和色泽上，大量选取了珍珠、贝壳、海螺等海边常见的元素。让人疑心，放在耳边的话，是否能听到海浪的声音。

【“不觉得它很像一条贝壳做成的鲸鱼吗？轻盈又自由。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
This exclusive edition of Solo features decorations and colors inspired by beach elements like pearls, shells, and conchs. It makes one wonder if, when held to the ear, you might hear the sound of ocean waves.

"Doesn't it look like a whale made of shells? Light and free."

Tips.SourceString:
“独舞”的改装版本。利用艳色、渐变和网格突显了科技感。额外增加的按键，也深得游戏群体的青睐。

【“按什么键出什么音，包括对手的尖叫。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A modified version of Solo. It features gradients, bright colors, and grids to emphasize a futuristic feel. The additional buttons are also highly favored by gamers.

"Press a key, get a sound, and hear your opponents' screams."

Tips.SourceString:
“独舞”的改装版本，芙拉薇娅刚进入欧泊时执行特工任务，常常携带这把武器，它的线条简洁流畅，正如每次的任务结果一样清晰。

【“我不需要实体的警戒线，看到这把枪了吗？往外延伸十米，都是危险范围。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The modified Solo was Flavia's go-to weapon during her early missions with P.U.S. Its clean design echoes the precision of her successful missions.

"This gun sets the boundary—ten meters out is where danger starts."

Tips.SourceString:
“独舞”的方程式竞赛定制版，以驾驶员视角作为涂装。这是作为赛车手的芙拉薇娅最熟悉的领域。

【“即使是我，也偶尔会被激起胜负心呢。抱歉，只能给你看个背影了。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Formula Race edition of Solo offers a driver's-eye view, perfectly suited to Flavia's racing skills.

"Even I get fired up sometimes. Sorry, but you'll just be chasing my trail."

Tips.SourceString:
“独舞”的暗黑哥特风格改装版，灵蝶于骸骨之上扇动翅膀，似乎在为逝去的生命哀悼——尽管这些生命是因为被灵蝶吸引，才踏入这座墓园。

【“阖眼安息吧，这不是死亡，只是永久的安眠。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Gothic-style Solo showcases a spirit butterfly fluttering over bones, as if mourning the departed, despite being the very lure that led them to this graveyard.

"Rest in peace. There is no death - only eternal slumber."

Tips.SourceString:
朝朝暮暮，永恒存续；月相流转，生生不息。凡人无法逃脱，但也只有当子弹射入眉心时才能知道，这是救赎还是终结。

【“洒下的月光是视线，而头顶的夜空遍布我的眼眸。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
From dawn to dusk, the cycle is eternal; as the moon phases, life endures. Mortals are bound by it, discovering their fate only when a bullet hits its mark.

"Moonlight casts my sight, and the starry sky holds my watchful gaze."

Tips.SourceString: 玛拉随身携带的武器。枪尾的一抹暗红犹如死神的镰刀，是死亡即将到来的先兆。
Tips.LocalizedString: Mara's signature weapon. A streak of crimson at the end of the barrel resembles the scythe of the Grim Reaper, a harbinger of imminent death.

Tips.SourceString: “破碎线条”系列涂装，线条的断点恰到好处，增加了视觉的冲击力，以极简的设计传递出了颇具层次与不和谐的美感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Fractured Lines series uses artfully broken lines to enhance visual impact. Its minimalist design conveys a layered and discordant beauty.

Tips.SourceString: “青春迷彩”系列涂装，经过某位白芸艺术馆设计师改良设计，颜色更加活泼明快，颇具青春的气息。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Youthful Camo series, redesigned by a Cloudscape Gallery designer, features vibrant and lively colors, exuding a fresh, youthful vibe.

Tips.SourceString: “红与黑”系列涂装，以剪刀手的标志色为主色调，反叛色彩与不拘一格的形状诉说着剪刀手的反叛精神，这种涂装在老一派剪刀手成员中非常常见。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Riot series features The Scissors' iconic colors and an unconventional design that symbolizes their rebellious nature, making this design popular among veteran members.

Tips.SourceString: “跃动”系列涂装，色彩炫丽时尚，富有活力激情，该涂装系列在新晋剪刀手成员之间颇受欢迎。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Vibrancy series boasts a colorful and energetic design, making it a favorite among new members of The Scissors.

Tips.SourceString: "碎梦"系列涂装，由不规则蓝色色块堆叠而成，图案中偶尔掺杂少量黄色碎片，给人以强烈的破碎感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Dreambreaker series combines patchy blues with occasional yellow fragments for a striking, shattered effect.

Tips.SourceString: “叛逆”系列涂装，色彩搭配反差感极强，图案设计状如一道迅捷有力的闪电，恰到好处地诠释了反叛与不羁的精神。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Rebel series features a striking color contrast and a pattern design resembling a swift, powerful lightning bolt, perfectly capturing the spirit of rebellion and defiance.

Tips.SourceString: “涂痕”系列涂装，为了让各地的来客能够深入体验乌尔比诺的潮流文化，长廊绘制所以喷漆，涂鸦为元素设计了一批枪械。派发在乌尔比诺各区的街头。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Graffiti series by Corridor Artisans creatively combines spray and street art elements, bringing Urbino's vibrant culture to life.

Tips.SourceString: “掠食者”系列涂装，仿生迷彩的设计不仅提供了良好的复杂环境隐蔽能力，也象征着战士们强大的武力。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Predator series features a bionic camo design, offering excellent camouflage in complex environments.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“浪人”系列枪械造型，神秘迷幻的紫色枪身中仿佛有浪花跃动，抚慰着每一位浪人的心。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Ronin series produced by Quadrant Foundries features waves dancing on a mysterious and psychedelic purple background, soothing the hearts of many wandering warriors.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“夏日派对”系列枪械造型，整体洋溢着轻松活跃的氛围，在战斗中甚至能起到鼓舞士气的作用。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Summer Party series by Polaris Labs exudes a relaxed and lively vibe. This firearm can boost morale even in the heat of battle.

Tips.SourceString: “夜镰”的古迹定制款，融入了希达半岛的民间传说与传统技艺，让现代枪械呈现出了古兵器的质感。或许，在战斗中使用它的人可以听到古老战士的祝福。
Tips.LocalizedString: A custom relic edition of Night Scythe, infused with folklore and traditional craftsmanship from the Seeda Peninsula, giving modern firearms the feel of ancient weaponry. Perhaps, those who wield it in battle can hear the blessings of ancient warriors.

Tips.SourceString:
“夜镰”的暗黑哥特风格改装版，作为亡灵女爵最珍爱的武器，其上遍生的荆棘与可怖的鬼面是死亡的具象化。

【“那个女人邀请我，我就来了。毕竟，对她的秘密我还有点儿兴趣。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Gothic-style Night Scythe is the Undead Countess's cherished weapon. Adorned with thorns and a haunting ghostly visage, it's the embodiment of death itself.

"She invited me, so I've come. After all, her secrets intrigue me."

Tips.SourceString: 微型冲锋枪，以超高射速和便携性被广泛熟知，是某些特殊兵种的首选。
Tips.LocalizedString: Micro SMG renowned for its ultra-high rate of fire and ease of concealment. Favored by many special force operatives.

Tips.SourceString: 短管霰弹枪，在同类中体积较小，同时又具备三发连射的特点，极适合近距离作战。
Tips.LocalizedString: Short-barrel shotgun, compact and ideal for close combat.

Tips.SourceString: 半自动手枪，手枪中的绝对王者，曾依靠其巨大的杀伤力闻名于世，其杀伤力在卡丘世界的手枪中亦不遑多让。
Tips.LocalizedString: Semi-automatic pistol, the undisputed king among handguns. Known worldwide for its immense power, it's just as lethal in Strinova.

Tips.SourceString: 手枪型特殊武器，可以近距离喷发伤害力极高的柱状火焰，瞬间让敌人葬身火焰型粒子波动中。
Tips.LocalizedString: Special pistol-like weapon that spits columns of flames at close range, instantly engulfing enemies in a wave of fiery particles.

Tips.SourceString: 拥有值得夸耀的射程和攻击力，射速极快。
Tips.LocalizedString: Boasts strong range and firepower, with a high rate of fire.

Tips.SourceString: 不知名的武器画家所制作，很有格调的武士刀。
Tips.LocalizedString: A super-stylish sword forged by an unknown master.

Tips.SourceString:
这柄独特的兵刃会让持有者涌起莫名的感悟：或许武器的强大不在于本身的锋利，而是一往无前燃烧自己的呐喊与决心。

【“全体单位注意！他们亮出了竞鸡！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Holding this weapon inspires the wielder to realize that true power lies not in its sharpness, but in the unwavering shout and determination.

"All units, be alert! They’ve brandished the Battle Rooster!"

Tips.SourceString:
传说在弦海中有着奇妙的精灵，她们承诺谁若是捞起那柄有着弦海气息的长剑，谁就能获得了弦海的肯定。但打捞者或许并不清楚，精灵的指引并非都是王的证明。

【“即使引导有些疏漏，也请您当上咸鱼之王。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Legends speak of mystical sprites in the ocean who promise that whoever retrieves the sword imbued with its essence will be deemed worthy to wield it. But the one who retrieves it may not know that not all guidance is a mark of royalty.

"Even if guidance falters, please become the King of Salty Fish"

Tips.SourceString:
沉入弦海，无法测定岁月的昔日之剑，剑身的铭文已经在悠久岁月中回归弦的源流，但剑刃依然迸发着如新生般惊心动魄的威能，只需要一位契合的持剑者，它就会重现那斩断一切战场的锋锐。

【“它创生的岁月，似是刹那璀璨的虹光；它重现的时代，将成永恒燃烧的曜轮。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
An ancient sword from the ocean's depths, its inscriptions have faded with time, yet the blade remains potent, waiting to awaken with the right wielder.

"Born in brief brilliance, it returns as an eternal blaze."

TweaponDescription.SourceString:
这是一件倾注心血的遗作。
致密的黑色组成柄体的大部。光滑的漆面有着手工打磨的痕迹，可延展的结构移动十分流畅，甚至连那螺栓的缝隙中，都找不到一粒杂尘。
我们仍未寻得它所属的时代，或是文明，或是所在的空间。它像是这片无尽弦海不经意间给予的馈赠，又像是沉入海中的先驱者留下的泪痕。
而它能够在弦海中保留其本征的特殊性，就足以让我们每一个人都将其视为珍宝：作为武器，它有着充分的锐利，足以匹敌当今的任何科技造物；作为文物，它有着足够的隐秘，能令所有的学者为解开隐秘的过往趋之若鹜。
现在，这柄被弃置在弦海中的兵器已经重现于这个逐渐动荡的时代，彷佛一则古老的箴言被重新唤醒：若要守护和平，无论何时，你需手持利剑。
TweaponDescription.LocalizedString:
This is a heartfelt masterpiece.
Crafted with dense black materials, the hilt has a lacquered finish, hand-polished to perfection. Its extendable structure moves seamlessly, leaving not a speck of dust even in the bolts.
We have yet to determine its era, civilization, or location. It could be an inadvertent gift from the ocean's depths or remnants of a pioneer submerged.
Its ability to retain its unique properties makes it a prized possession: sharp enough to rival modern weapons, and mysterious enough to entice any scholar.
Now, this weapon, once cast aside in the ocean, reappears in turbulent times, as if an ancient adage is revived: To guard peace, one must wield a sharp sword.

现在，这柄被弃置在弦海中的兵器已经重现于这个逐渐动荡的时代，彷佛一则古老的箴言被重新唤醒：若要守护和平，无论何时，你需手持利剑。

This is a heartfelt masterpiece.
