We have yet to determine its era, civilization, or location. It could be an inadvertent gift from the ocean's depths or remnants of a pioneer submerged.
Its ability to retain its unique properties makes it a prized possession: sharp enough to rival modern weapons, and mysterious enough to entice any scholar.
Now, this weapon, once cast aside in the ocean, reappears in turbulent times, as if an ancient adage is revived: To guard peace, one must wield a sharp sword.

Tips.SourceString: 不知名的武器画家所制作，很有格调的武士刀。
Tips.LocalizedString: A super-stylish sword forged by an unknown master.

Tips.SourceString:
这柄独特的兵刃会让持有者涌起莫名的感悟：或许武器的强大不在于本身的锋利，而是一往无前燃烧自己的呐喊与决心。

【“全体单位注意！他们亮出了竞鸡！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Holding this weapon inspires the wielder to realize that true power lies not in its sharpness, but in the unwavering shout and determination.

"All units, be alert! They’ve brandished the Battle Rooster!"

Tips.SourceString:
传说在弦海中有着奇妙的精灵，她们承诺谁若是捞起那柄有着弦海气息的长剑，谁就能获得了弦海的肯定。但打捞者或许并不清楚，精灵的指引并非都是王的证明。

【“即使引导有些疏漏，也请您当上咸鱼之王。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Legends speak of mystical sprites in the ocean who promise that whoever retrieves the sword imbued with its essence will be deemed worthy to wield it. But the one who retrieves it may not know that not all guidance is a mark of royalty.

"Even if guidance falters, please become the King of Salty Fish"

Tips.SourceString: 在投出后的一定时间引爆，可产生不俗的范围伤害。
Tips.LocalizedString: Detonates shortly after impact, causing significant area damage.

Tips.SourceString: 都给我站一起！我要开始闹了！
Tips.LocalizedString: Gather up! It's time for chaos!

Tips.SourceString: 在投出后的一定时间引爆，可产生不俗的范围伤害。
Tips.LocalizedString: Detonates shortly after impact, causing significant area damage.

Tips.SourceString: 在投出后的一定时间引爆，释放强光，当敌人和自己在爆炸点一定范围内看到闪光时，会被暂时致盲并干扰听觉。
Tips.LocalizedString: Emits a bright flash shortly after impact, causing temporary blindness and deafness to anyone within range who witnesses the flash.

Tips.SourceString: 请看好哦，我要为大家带来最闪耀的冰花！
Tips.LocalizedString: Look closely, I'm about to dazzle you all with icy blooms!

Tips.SourceString: 在投出并落地后的短时间内激活，释放一片阻挡视野的烟雾。
Tips.LocalizedString: Activates shortly after impact, releasing a smoke screen that obstructs vision.

Tips.SourceString: 在投出并落地后的短时间内激活，制造一小片足以将人吹起的风场，在其持续时间内使风场中的所有单位强制飘飞。
Tips.LocalizedString: Activates shortly after impact, creating a small, powerful gust of wind that forcibly floats all units within the wind field for its duration.

Tips.SourceString: 在投出并落地后的短时间内激活，炸开一大滩颜料，在其持续时间内使范围内的敌方单位被大幅减速并禁止弦化。
Tips.LocalizedString: Activates shortly after impact, releasing a large pool of paint that greatly slows and string-blocks enemies within range.

Tips.SourceString: 你说的……走不动……是什么……？
Tips.LocalizedString: "You said... you can't move... what's that... about?"

Tips.SourceString: 在投出并落地后的短时间内激活，炸开一大滩颜料，在其持续时间内使范围内的敌方单位被大幅减速并禁止弦化。
Tips.LocalizedString: Activates shortly after impact, releasing a large pool of paint that greatly slows and string-blocks enemies within range.

Tips.SourceString: 在投出并受到撞击后激活，展开一片治疗云雾，令其范围内的我方单位短暂回复生命值。
Tips.LocalizedString: Releases a healing mist on impact, temporarily restoring health to allies in its area.

Tips.SourceString: 超越光速才能够回到过去？只是轻轻拨动指针就能够做到了。
Tips.LocalizedString: "Returning to the past isn’t about speed, just adjust the dial slightly."

Tips.SourceString: 投出后附着在物体表面，在一段时间内感应其周围，有敌方单位经过时发出警报。
Tips.LocalizedString: Attaches to a surface and senses its surroundings, emitting an alarm when enemies pass by.

Tips.SourceString: 投出落地后，展开一个透明护罩，在其持续时间内拦截所有敌方战术道具。敌人视角下，只有在其展开与拦截时此护罩才可视。
Tips.LocalizedString: Deploys a transparent shield on impact that intercepts enemy tactical items. The shield becomes visible to enemies only when intercepting.

Tips.SourceString: 无法描述的概念却有着吸引一切的性质，包括人们的想象力。
Tips.LocalizedString: "An indescribable concept with the power to pull in everything, including imagination."

Tips.SourceString: 战斗步枪，兼顾了威力与稳定性，古地球工业化的优秀之作。配备1.25倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: Balancing power and stability, this battle rifle is a fine example of Earth's industrial craftsmanship. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “余烬”系列涂装，由焰的橙色与烬的灰色交映而成。
Tips.LocalizedString: Embers series paint job featuring fiery orange and ashy gray.

Tips.SourceString: “多维”系列涂装，以卡拉彼丘图案为设计锚点，简约却不简单的图形中，流溢着别样的设计魅力。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Multiverse" series features a Strinova-inspired design. Its simple yet intricate patterns exude a unique charm.

Tips.SourceString: “热情”系列涂装，URB-00定制款，艳丽乖张的色彩彰显最为新潮的理念，深受乌尔比诺成员们的喜爱。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Ardor" series, URB-00 custom edition, features vibrant, edgy colors that reflect the latest trends, and is a favorite among Urbino members.

Tips.SourceString: “错觉”系列涂装，以蓝色调为主，混合扭曲的色彩看似在流动一般，表现出复杂动态的变形之美。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Illusion" series, this firearm's blue highlights twist and turn, as if melting into the design.

Tips.SourceString: “嵌合”系列涂装，深浓浅淡，错落有致的橙色马赛克涂装，带来独特而充满视觉效果的艺术感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Chimera" series features an elegant orange mosaic design with deep and light tones, creating an artistic look.

Tips.SourceString: “棱镜”系列涂装，不同深浅的紫红色调，仿佛在棱镜碎片中折射，显现出万花筒一般的美感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Prisma" series uses refractive fragmentation, with artistic purple shades evoking a kaleidoscopic feeling.

Tips.SourceString: “蜂巢”系列涂装，充满科技感的蓝紫色，赋以六角形的边界图案，体现出严谨而精密的科学之美。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Hive" series features a tech-inspired blue and purple theme with hexagrammic border designs, showcasing the beauty of precise and meticulous science.

Tips.SourceString: “交错线”系列涂装，以暗色为敌，用交叉，叠加的线条作为主要的图形，在视觉上具有一定的迷惑性。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Crisscross series features a dark base with intersecting lines, creating a dazzling display on the battlefield.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“占星”系列枪械造型，神秘与潮流的结合，长廊绘制所内画师们的呕心沥血之作。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Astrologist" series by Corridor Artisans is a careful blend of mystery and trend, said to be the painstaking work of their top artist.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“漫画之星”系列枪械造型，于枪身中央增添了客户定制的艺术头像，配以精心搭配的色块设计，更好地还原了客户们的个性化需求。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Manga Star" series by Corridor Artisans showcases a customized avatar at the center of the gun, enhanced with thoughtfully designed color blocks to accentuate clients' unique preferences.

Tips.SourceString: “纸牌屋”系列涂装，以绿心桃形作为主体，充满活力的乌尔比诺成员今天也在为了自由和艺术而战。
Tips.LocalizedString: A model in the "House of Cards" series, coveted by Urbino fighters who favor bringing this artistic weapon into battle.

Tips.SourceString: “飞鸟”系列主题涂装，生动描绘了多种鸟类动物的活泼生态，仔细观察似乎还被涂画上了使用者的个性符号。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Aviary" series imitates a lively avian ecosystem and subtly includes the user's personal symbol.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“幻海”系列枪械造型，将海洋元素融入枪身之内，又附以如梦似幻的渐变配色，大大加强了枪械的整体艺术感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Mystic Ocean" series by Corridor Artisans beautifully blends oceanic elements with dreamlike gradient colors, enhancing the firearm's artistic appeal.

Tips.SourceString: “齿锋”的特殊定制版，据说灵感源于某次乌尔比诺音乐节的摇滚演出。
Tips.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Tips.SourceString:
“齿锋”的概念客制型号，造型灵感源于的昔日的猎人。在过去的时代，人们畏惧那些在夜晚中游荡的狩猎者，因为没有人知道，自己是否就是其目标。

【她悄无声息，带来无法预知的命运。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Sawtooth concept custom model draws inspiration from ancient hunters. In times past, people feared those nocturnal stalkers, never knowing if they were the next target.

"In complete silence, she delivers an unpredictable fate."

Tips.SourceString:
“齿锋”的特别定制型号，该型号除了采用了更加流线型的外观以外也增添了仿生学动力部件，在射击的同时会展开部件填充气动平衡鳍，根据绯莎本人自称除了很炫酷以外或许能更好的有助于滑空射击，至少她是这么说的。

【“炫酷也是战斗力，明白吗？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The custom Sawtooth model features an aerodynamic design and advanced biomechanical components. When firing, it deploys balance fins to optimize shooting precision. According to Fuchsia, looking cool isn’t just a bonus—it’s part of the power.

“Being cool is a form of power, got it?”

Tips.SourceString:
绯莎参加节日游行时所使用的武器，罗盘针式的定位装置有助于分析敌我方向，帮助绯莎更好的把握战况。

【“躲躲藏藏的真没意思。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Fuchsia's weapon for festival parades features a compass-based positioning system, aiding in analyzing enemy and ally locations to better grasp the situation.

"Hiding is no fun."

Tips.SourceString:
“齿锋”的迷彩改装型，整体造型采用了迷彩涂装以外更是加入了仿生科技……至于有什么用？也许它还能帮你驱赶一下身边的蚊虫？

【“多亏了它，至少在潜伏的时候我不用担心被蚊子咬得满身大包了。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A camo-modified version of Sawtooth. Beyond its camouflage design, it features bionic technology... What's it for? Maybe it even helps repel mosquitoes.

"Thanks to it, I no longer have to worry about getting mosquito bites while in hiding."

Tips.SourceString:
“齿锋”的客制化枪械外观，枪身轻盈但动力极强，能够像吸尘器一样高效率地清理一切多余碍事的“垃圾尘垢”。

【“女仆的清洁工作，当然是用子弹来完成。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Custom Sawtooth model. Lightweight yet powerful, it clears away any unwanted 'trash and debris' like a vacuum.

"Cleaning like a maid, but with bullets."

Tips.SourceString:
齿锋的特殊改造版，巧妙地将部件替换成了能用于度量计算的工具。毕竟一名优秀的调酒师，对酒的品质必然有精准的把控能力。

【“再多一点麦芽的香气吧，目前我对这杯酒的评分，只有99.5。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A specially modded version of Sawtooth, featuring tools for precise measurement. A skilled bartender knows that controlling drink quality is essential.

"Let's add a touch more malt aroma. My current rating for this drink is only 99.5."

Tips.SourceString:
“齿锋”的深海特供版，或许是受到浪漫深海的感染，齿锋也褪去锋芒，摇身一变成可爱的海洋精灵，只为自由与碧海而生。

【“如若不是为了生存，或许我也能像它们一样自由地遨游于海。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Sawtooth deep-sea edition, inspired by the enchanting ocean depths, transforms into an adorable sea pixie, embracing the essence of freedom and the vast ocean.

"If not for survival, I might roam the seas, as free as they are."

Tips.SourceString:
“齿缝”的改造版本，从小陪伴绯莎长大，一直被她带在身边。枪身虽冰冷，但在绯莎心中，却是有温度的。
【“宗师之路，并非我一人独行。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The modified Sawtooth has been by Fuchsia's side since childhood. Its cold barrel holds warmth in her heart.

"The path to mastery is not one I walk alone."

Tips.SourceString:
“齿锋”的客制化枪械外观，由枪战游戏主办方进行了迷彩喷涂的处理，不论在何种战场上，猎鲨好战的本性都不曾改变。

【“猎鲨正在饥饿之中，谁来成为我的养料？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized version of Sawtooth, featuring camouflage painting by the host of a shooter game. No matter the battlefield, the shark's aggressive nature remains unchanged.

“The shark is hungry. Who will become my prey?”

Tips.SourceString: “齿锋”的校园日定制款，结合了多种日常文具重新设计的涂装，回家以后就赶紧完成作业，然后开始愉快地放空自己享受生活吧。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Campus Open Day edition of Sawtooth blends various daily stationery into its design. Finish your homework quickly, then relax and enjoy life!

Tips.SourceString:
“齿锋”的个人特别定制款，仿照古地球的鲨鱼骨架而设计，搭载性能优异的发光元件，再现了这种深海巨兽往昔的威猛，以及孤独。

【卡丘世界的海底生态链是断裂的，在迁移而来的海洋生物中，只有鲨鱼活了下来。但鲨鱼却变得不再敏锐而强大，连嗅觉都逐渐丧失。人们只能借助仿生技术还原鲨鱼从前的模样。
在接到改装完成的“齿锋”后，绯莎不由得感叹每一个细节都还原得如此精妙。
“没什么大不了的，只是按照某条从深海打捞上来的亡鲨骨架等比例还原的。”
枪械改造师不以为然地挑了挑眉毛。
“深海？这个世界的海洋中存在着鲨鱼？”
“是啊，不过很遗憾，现在只剩下一条还活着了……听生命改良部的同事说它最近似乎变得无比狂躁。”
鲨鱼是一种独行而沉稳的生物，为什么会平白无故地变得狂躁？绯莎非常想知道鲨鱼狂躁的原因。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized edition of the Sawtooth, inspired by the skeleton of a shark from old Earth. Equipped with high-performance light elements, recreating the might and solitude of the deep-sea beast.

Strinova's marine ecosystem is broken. Among the ocean's migratory creatures, only the sharks survived. Yet, they have lost their sharpness and strength, and even their sense of smell is fading. Bionic technology was needed to restore their former glory.
When Fuchsia received the modified Sawtooth, she couldn't help but admire the exquisite attention to detail.
“No big deal. It's only a scaled replica of a shark skeleton salvaged from the deep sea.”
The gunsmith remarks with a nonchalant raise of his eyebrow.
“The deep sea? Are there still sharks out there?
“Sadly, there remains just one... My colleague from Bionic Tech mentioned it's been extremely agitated lately."
Sharks are typically solitary and composed, so why this sudden agitation? Fuchsia is eager to uncover the reason behind the shark's unusual behavior.

Tips.SourceString: 突击步枪，无托系列步枪中的代表之作，综合素质极其优秀，古地球轻武器中的经典。配备1.25倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: The standout bullpup rifle, known for its exceptional all-around performance. A classic from old Earth firearms. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “魅紫”系列涂装，以明亮的紫色填充枪身，赋予枪身独特的神秘感。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Arcane Purple" series, this firearm, adorned in bright purple, exudes a sense of mystery.

Tips.SourceString: “浪潮”系列涂装，以蓝色色块组合模拟海浪的造型，虽无潮声，却也沁人心脾。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Tidal Wave" series is composed of a series of blue modules meant to imitate the shape of a wave. It may lack the sound of the sea, but it remains a delight.

Tips.SourceString: “霓虹”系列涂装，SCIS-08定制款，叛逆不羁的色彩搭配，受到剪刀手阵营的青睐。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Neon" SCIS-08 custom edition showcases The Scissors' bold rebellion with its edgy color scheme.

Tips.SourceString: “紫金”系列涂装，别出心裁的紫金撞色搭配给予枪身别样的质感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Violet Gold series features a unique blend of purple and gold, giving the weapon a distinct texture.

Tips.SourceString: “迷彩”系列涂装，枪身上多样的色彩融合，很好地达到了融入自然环境的效果。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Camo" series. The firearm features perfect textures to blend seamlessly into natural environments.

Tips.SourceString: “信念”系列涂装，黑底，配上剪刀手徽记与涂鸦，肃杀中彰显出持有者坚定的意志。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Faith" series features a black base with The Scissors emblem, showcasing the holder's unwavering resolve.

Tips.SourceString: “冲浪”系列涂装，使用简约的色块勾勒出了沙滩与海浪的景象，拿在手上仿佛也能乘上海浪勇往直前。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Wave Surfer" series evokes beachside wave imagery with its minimalist blockish color design.

Tips.SourceString: “交错线”系列涂装，以暗色为敌，用交叉，叠加的线条作为主要的图形，在视觉上具有一定的迷惑性。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Crisscross series features a dark base with intersecting lines, creating a dazzling display on the battlefield.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“浪人”系列枪械造型，神秘迷幻的紫色枪身中仿佛有浪花跃动，抚慰着每一位浪人的心。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Ronin series produced by Quadrant Foundries features waves dancing on a mysterious and psychedelic purple background, soothing the hearts of many wandering warriors.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“夏日海滩”系列枪械造型，完美地将不同种类的海滩元素附着于枪身之上，宁静时刻，甚至能听见海潮的回响。
Tips.LocalizedString: Manufactured by Quadrant Foundries, the Summer Beach series of firearms perfectly blends various beach elements onto the barrel. In tranquil moments, you might even hear the echo of the waves.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“Q版世界”系列枪械造型，将定制者的Q版三视图融入视觉设计中，为枪身赋予轻松气息的同时，更好地满足了客制化需求。
Tips.LocalizedString: Manufactured by Quadrant Foundries, the "Chibi World" series of firearms features custom Chibi-style art, adding a relaxed vibe to the barrel while fulfilling customization needs.

Tips.SourceString: “纸牌屋”系列涂装，以红心黑方作为主题，身着华服的Q版剪刀手成员惟妙惟肖，彰显贵气之感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series features a tasteful heart and black square palette, adorned with elegant chibi versions of The Scissors, exuding a sense of luxury.

Tips.SourceString: “龙腾虎跃”系列涂装，以黄白二色凸显喜庆之感，刻画舞狮的剪刀手队员们跃然而上，凸显龙马精神。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Lion Dance" series features a festive yellow and white design, depicting Scissors members performing lion dances, embodying spirit and vitality.

Tips.SourceString: 格罗夫集团出品，“回味时光”咖啡厅同名主题涂装，依据持有者的喜好进行了个性化设计。不论是难眠的深夜，亦或是悠闲的午后，这杯咖啡都为你带来了一段值得回味的香浓时光。
Tips.LocalizedString: Produced by Grove Enterprises, the "Café Reminiscence" themed design is personalized according to the owner's taste. Whether it's a restless night or a relaxing afternoon, this coffee will bring you a rich and memorable experience.

Tips.SourceString:
“隼”的艺术特化型号，设计理念参考了古地球的埃及文化，将旧日的繁盛与威严倾注其中，仿佛重新唤起了那个传说的时代。

【我未曾见过那样一个极盛的时代。
那时的黄金覆满大地，流沙之上，佳酿与蜜的歌谣口口传唱，歌不尽千年的繁盛时光。
而如今，
烫金的面具雍容依旧，古老的权柄威严如昨，
万般辉煌过往，徒留余晖闪烁。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
An artistic version of the Falcon, inspired by ancient Earth's Egyptian culture. It channels the civilization's former glory, reawakening a legendary era.

"I had never witnessed such a glorious era.
Gold covered the land. Above the shifting sands, songs of fine wine and honey were sung, a fragment of its endless glory.
But now,
the gilded masks remain elegant, the ancient power still commanding,
a shimmering brilliance from a distant past."

Tips.SourceString:
“隼”的艺术特化型号，略显得夸张的结构设计中融入了最新潮的漫画元素。若是能将它携带在身边，连战斗也不再残酷。


【“喂！？”“在吗？”“哎哟！”
正交火呢，枪身上忽的蹦出了漫画中的对话框。
这样一来，就连原本严肃的战斗，都变得有趣起来了。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The artistic Falcon model comes alive with a bold, modern manga book flair. Its exaggerated design offers a fun twist, making battles feel less intense.

"Hey?!" "Anyone there?!" "Ouch!"
Amidst the gunfire, a manga-style speech bubble pops from the gun.
Suddenly, the once-serious battle isn't so serious anymore.

Tips.SourceString:
剪刀手在普雷顿义演时梅瑞狄斯所使用的武器，装饰着花牌的枪械，除了能够用来扰乱敌人的判断，也是用来表演魔术的道具之一。

【“惊喜……也可能是惊吓哦？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Meredith's weapon during The Scissors' charity event in Preton. Decorated with playing cards, it confuses enemies and doubles as a magic prop.

“Surprised... or perhaps shocked?”

Tips.SourceString:
“隼”的个人定制款，考究的皮革下包裹着精细的地图与罗盘，除了命中劲敌，也始终指引着她在未知与混沌中寻求真理。

【深入观察，仔细思考——路，在何方？】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized version of the "Falcon" featuring a detailed map and compass meticulously wrapped in leather. It not only leads her to her nemesis but also guides her in seeking the truth amidst the unknown chaos.

"Observe carefully and think deeply. Where does the path lead?"

Tips.SourceString:
“隼”的客制化改造款，梅瑞狄斯将枪身改造成摇滚吉他，甚至植入了完备的音响装置。这种大胆新奇的设计，便于梅瑞狄斯随时随地地进行即兴演出，只是她的摇滚具备过于强大的冲击力与破坏力。

【“梅瑞狄斯教授，在您开始摇滚前，请允许我们提前备好耳塞……”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Meredith's custom Falcon revamp, designed to resemble a rock guitar complete with a sound system. This daring innovation lets her perform on the spot, though her rock music is notoriously intense and destructive.

"Professor Meredith, before you start rocking out, please let us prepare our earplugs..."

Tips.SourceString:
“隼”的客制化枪械外观，典雅华贵的外观下，无比精确地计算着每一分每一秒，非常适配梅瑞狄斯严谨周密的工作习惯。

【“工作提前结束了，但是，客人，对你的观察会一直进行。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Customized Falcon model. With its elegant design, it tracks every moment precisely, perfectly matching Meredith's meticulous habits.

"I have done my work ahead of my schedule. My observation on you will countinue, though."

Tips.SourceString:
“隼”的地下酒吧特供版。当远方来客翩然而至时，她随身携带的枪械，似乎也在看着这一切。

【“放心吧，我不会带来什么，也不会带走什么，我只是旁观者。地下酒吧发生的一切，就看各位表演了。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Falcon underground bar model. As guests from afar gracefully arrive, her weapon seems to be watching it all.

"Don't worry. I'm bringing nothing in and taking nothing out. I'm just an observer. Whatever happens here is up to you."

Tips.SourceString:
“隼”的泳池派对特供版。低调与奢华尽显于黑金的色调中，正如庆典总设计师一以贯之的理念：极简亦是美丽。

【“我曾经驾驶摩托艇驰骋于海面，连海风都无法追上我。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The exclusive Falcon pool party edition. The black and gold tones radiate understated luxury, embodying the designer's principle: simplicity is beauty.

"I once rode a jet ski across the waves so swiftly that even the sea breeze couldn't catch up to me."

Tips.SourceString:
“隼”的改装版本，霓之城中欧泊与剪刀手的追逐战就好似猫捉老鼠的游戏，而“猫派”的成员总是对“鼠”情有独钟，这一点也体现在了枪械的设计上。

【“在这座城市里，你们才是猎物。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A modified version of the Falcon. In Neon City, P.U.S and The Scissors are in a never-ending cat-and-mouse game. The cats have a particular fondness for chasing the mice, which is reflected in the firearm's design.

“In this city, you are the prey.”

Tips.SourceString:
“隼”的特殊改造款，外部包裹着流动的液态水银，从不同角度观察呈现为不同的颜色，似乎有让人一旦注意到、便无法移开视线的魔力。偶有黑色尖刺与毒液从中渗出，但定睛一看却又会立刻消散。

【“武器当然没有属于自己的思想，它的外在，皆为汝等意志之呈现。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A specially modified version of the Falcon, enveloped in flowing liquid mercury. From different angles, it displays a spectrum of colors, possessing an entrancing allure that's hard to look away from. Occasional black spikes and venom ooze out but quickly vanish upon closer inspection.

"Weapons lack their own thoughts; their appearance is merely a reflection of your will."

Tips.SourceString: 突击步枪，散热良好和耐久性是其优势，近程点射时精准度颇佳。此外，还有如扳机扣力柔和、左右手均可使用等注重舒适度的设计。配备1.25倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: Excellent heat dissipation and durability. Top accuracy for close-range shots, a smooth trigger pull, and ambidextrous design for comfort. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “紫晶”系列涂装，深沉的紫色保留内涵，亮蓝的条带赋予活力。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Amethyst series blends rich purple tones for depth with vibrant blue stripes for a lively touch.

Tips.SourceString: “多维”系列涂装，以卡拉彼丘图案为设计锚点，简约却不简单的图形中，流溢着别样的设计魅力。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Multiverse" series features a Strinova-inspired design. Its simple yet intricate patterns exude a unique charm.

Tips.SourceString: “热情”系列涂装，URB-00定制款，艳丽乖张的色彩彰显最为新潮的理念，深受乌尔比诺成员们的喜爱。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Ardor" series, URB-00 custom edition, features vibrant, edgy colors that reflect the latest trends, and is a favorite among Urbino members.

Tips.SourceString: “错觉”系列涂装，以蓝色调为主，混合扭曲的色彩看似在流动一般，表现出复杂动态的变形之美。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Illusion" series, this firearm's blue highlights twist and turn, as if melting into the design.

Tips.SourceString: “嵌合”系列涂装，深浓浅淡，错落有致的橙色马赛克涂装，带来独特而充满视觉效果的艺术感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Chimera" series features an elegant orange mosaic design with deep and light tones, creating an artistic look.

Tips.SourceString: “棱镜”系列涂装，不同深浅的紫红色调，仿佛在棱镜碎片中折射，显现出万花筒一般的美感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Prisma" series uses refractive fragmentation, with artistic purple shades evoking a kaleidoscopic feeling.

Tips.SourceString: “蜂巢”系列涂装，充满科技感的蓝紫色，赋以六角形的边界图案，体现出严谨而精密的科学之美。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Hive" series features a tech-inspired blue and purple theme with hexagrammic border designs, showcasing the beauty of precise and meticulous science.

Tips.SourceString: “锦鲤”系列涂装，斑驳的红黑配色如同火药与烈焰，希望面对它的人能够走运。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Koi" series features a red and black pattern reminiscent of fire and gunpowder, bringing good luck to those who encounter it.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“占星”系列枪械造型，神秘与潮流的结合，长廊绘制所内画师们的呕心沥血之作。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Astrologist" series by Corridor Artisans is a careful blend of mystery and trend, said to be the painstaking work of their top artist.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“漫画之星”系列枪械造型，于枪身中央增添了客户定制的艺术头像，配以精心搭配的色块设计，更好地还原了客户们的个性化需求。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Manga Star" series by Corridor Artisans showcases a customized avatar at the center of the gun, enhanced with thoughtfully designed color blocks to accentuate clients' unique preferences.

Tips.SourceString: “纸牌屋”系列涂装，以绿心桃形作为主体，充满活力的乌尔比诺成员今天也在为了自由和艺术而战。
Tips.LocalizedString: A model in the "House of Cards" series, coveted by Urbino fighters who favor bringing this artistic weapon into battle.

Tips.SourceString: “暗金浪涌”系列主题涂装，由偏光实验室推出的枪械涂装，主打暗金色调，在保证酷炫拉风的同时，也颇具金属般的沉稳感与力量感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Golden Surge" series, launched by Polaris Labs, features a dark gold pattern that combines a cool, flashy look with a powerful sense of metallic stability.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“幻海”系列枪械造型，将海洋元素融入枪身之内，又附以如梦似幻的渐变配色，大大加强了枪械的整体艺术感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Mystic Ocean" series by Corridor Artisans beautifully blends oceanic elements with dreamlike gradient colors, enhancing the firearm's artistic appeal.

Tips.SourceString:
“北极星”的私人定制款，夺目的鲜红玫瑰绽放于枪身之上，而代表着守护的骑士之剑则横贯其中，似乎在诉说着一段绝美的故事。

【人如蔷薇，剑也如蔷薇。
以烈火为魂，以钢铁为骨。
当枪火激烈冲突时，蔷薇随之灿烂绽放。
踏上战场的绯红少女，心中早已做好凋零的觉悟。
于她小憩片刻，轻抚花朵之时。
她心中那片柔软的蔷薇园，又会留给谁呢？】
Tips.LocalizedString:
This customized version of the Polaris features a striking scarlet rose in full bloom. A sword of knightly protection cuts through the design, telling a tale of beauty and valor.

"As roses mirror people, so do swords.
Fueled by fire, built with steel.
In fierce battles, roses bloom.
The scarlet maiden on the battlefield has long accepted her fate to wither.
Yet in her moments of resting, as she gently caresses the petals,
who will be the one to cherish the garden within her heart?"

Tips.SourceString:
“北极星”的艺术设计款，将旧日地球的童话元素合于枪械改装中，透露着设计者内心的纯真。

【那里有易碎的梦境，孩童的天真，善意和最初的纯然。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Artistic Polaris model. References to fairy tales from old Earth reveal a surprising innocence in this weapon's designer.

【Wrapped in fragile dreams, a child's innocence beams. Kindness and purity, in our essence, gleams.】

Tips.SourceString:
“北极星”的私人订制型号，巧妙地融入了医护理念，似乎还有着暗示反战的意味……

【他们的救死扶伤不是为了赞美，他们举起枪，也不是为了争斗。
他们的身前是战争，而身后是和平。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Polaris custom model cleverly incorporates medical themes, seemingly implying anti-war ideals...

They save lives not in the hope of praise, nor do they raise their guns to fight.
In front of them lies war, and behind them, peace.

Tips.SourceString:
“北极星”的特殊改装款，该枪械是在星绘游玩太空体验馆时所获得的礼品，被做成了空间站样式的枪械诉说着人类向往无尽苍穹的梦想，可以说是工业艺术的结晶也不为过。

【“为无尽的星空，献上无尽的憧憬与爱。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The specialized "Polaris" Model was a gift obtained from the Celestia Space Center. Designed to resemble a space station, it symbolizes humanity's dream of reaching the endless cosmos. It's no exaggeration to call this weapon a masterpiece of industrial art.

"To the endless sky, I offer my endless longing and love."

Tips.SourceString:
“北极星”的特殊定制型号，这把枪与原型最大的区别是褪去了兵器的冰冷感，更加适合出门邀约所携带，瞄准镜兼用了补妆镜的功能，让使用者能够随时检查自己的妆容。

【“刚刚玩的太痛快了，得赶快补个妆才行……嘿嘿。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A custom version of the Polaris, this model loses the original's cold weapon vibe, making it perfect for date nights. The scope also serves as a makeup mirror, enabling users to check their makeup anytime, anywhere.

"That was such a blast! I need to touch up my makeup... Heh.”

Tips.SourceString:
“北极星”的个人定制化型号，整体枪械进行了圆滑处理，更加贴合射手的手感的同时，作为点缀的苍色结晶片可以为整个枪身提供能源，迸发出的子弹想必也是如同流星一样奔向目标吧。

【“这可不是一般的许愿星，它会永远飞向我期望的目标。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special customized version of the Polaris featuring a smoothed barrel that provides better grip. The embellished azure crystals also serve as an energy source for the firearm, enabling its bullets to race toward the targets like shooting stars.

"This is no ordinary wishing star. It always flies toward my desired target."

Tips.SourceString:
“北极星”的改造版本，加入了三色堇、珍珠、玉佩等要素，比起武器来说更像是一件工艺品。

【“将光芒和希望，射向宇宙的每一个角落。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
An upgraded Polaris, with touches of pansies, pearls, and jade. It resembles a piece of fine art rather than a mere weapon.

"Project light and hope across the universe."

Tips.SourceString:
“北极星”的田园生活改造款。侍弄花草的时候，一只鹦鹉落在了星绘的肩头，还毫不怕生的轻啄她的发丝。星绘将这个有趣的景象设计成了涂装。

【“这么自来熟的小鸟，倒是和米雪儿的性格有点像呢。带回去给她看看吧。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Inspired by rural charm, this Polaris model captures a serene moment when a parrot landed on Celestia’s shoulder, gently tugging her hair as she gardened.

"This outgoing little bird is so much like Michele. She'd love to see this."

Tips.SourceString:
“北极星”的“沐春节”特供版，以“蛟龙出海”为寓意而设计，寄托着星绘在过去的困难中一点点积攒的勇气与决心。

【“为了病患，我不会再退缩了，这都是前辈教给我的呢。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The special Spring Blessings edition of "Polaris," inspired by the motif "Ascendance," embodies the courage and determination Celestia has gradually built up through past hardships.

“For the patients, I won't back down anymore. This is what my predecessors taught me.”

Tips.SourceString:
“北极星”的个人定制化型号，流动的赤色包裹住枪身，犹如被月光照耀的红宝石般迷人。

【“星星一定也听到了我们的祈愿，这璀璨的赤色星弦，就是我们心灵相通的证明。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized version of the Polaris, enveloped in flowing crimson that glistens like a ruby under moonlight.

"The stars must have heard our wishes; this brilliant crimson starstring is the proof of our connection."

Tips.SourceString: 反器材狙击枪。采用枪管短后坐原理，半自动发射方式，威力惊人。配备2.5倍瞄准镜，精准优雅，完美谢幕。
Tips.LocalizedString: Utilizing a short-recoil barrel system, the anti-material sniper rifle delivers astounding power. Equipped with a 2.5x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “霓虹”系列涂装，SCIS-08定制款，叛逆不羁的色彩搭配，受到剪刀手阵营的青睐。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Neon" SCIS-08 custom edition showcases The Scissors' bold rebellion with its edgy color scheme.

Tips.SourceString: “紫金”系列涂装，别出心裁的紫金撞色搭配给予枪身别样的质感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Violet Gold series features a unique blend of purple and gold, giving the weapon a distinct texture.

Tips.SourceString: “魅紫”系列涂装，以明亮的紫色填充枪身，赋予枪身独特的神秘感。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Arcane Purple" series, this firearm, adorned in bright purple, exudes a sense of mystery.

Tips.SourceString: “迷彩”系列涂装，枪身上多样的色彩融合，很好地达到了融入自然环境的效果。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Camo" series. The firearm features perfect textures to blend seamlessly into natural environments.

Tips.SourceString: “信念”系列涂装，黑底，配上剪刀手徽记与涂鸦，肃杀中彰显出持有者坚定的意志。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Faith" series features a black base with The Scissors emblem, showcasing the holder's unwavering resolve.

Tips.SourceString: “浪潮”系列涂装，以蓝色色块组合模拟海浪的造型，虽无潮声，却也沁人心脾。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Tidal Wave" series is composed of a series of blue modules meant to imitate the shape of a wave. It may lack the sound of the sea, but it remains a delight.

Tips.SourceString: “冲浪”系列涂装，使用简约的色块勾勒出了沙滩与海浪的景象，拿在手上仿佛也能乘上海浪勇往直前。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Wave Surfer" series evokes beachside wave imagery with its minimalist blockish color design.

Tips.SourceString: “交错线”系列涂装，以暗色为敌，用交叉，叠加的线条作为主要的图形，在视觉上具有一定的迷惑性。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Crisscross series features a dark base with intersecting lines, creating a dazzling display on the battlefield.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“浪人”系列枪械造型，神秘迷幻的紫色枪身中仿佛有浪花跃动，抚慰着每一位浪人的心。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Ronin series produced by Quadrant Foundries features waves dancing on a mysterious and psychedelic purple background, soothing the hearts of many wandering warriors.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“Q版世界”系列枪械造型，将定制者的Q版三视图融入视觉设计中，为枪身赋予轻松气息的同时，更好地满足了客制化需求。
Tips.LocalizedString: Manufactured by Quadrant Foundries, the "Chibi World" series of firearms features custom Chibi-style art, adding a relaxed vibe to the barrel while fulfilling customization needs.

Tips.SourceString: “纸牌屋”系列涂装，以红心黑方作为主题，身着华服的Q版剪刀手成员惟妙惟肖，彰显贵气之感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series features a tasteful heart and black square palette, adorned with elegant chibi versions of The Scissors, exuding a sense of luxury.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“夏日海滩”系列枪械造型，完美地将不同种类的海滩元素附着于枪身之上，宁静时刻，甚至能听见海潮的回响。
Tips.LocalizedString: Manufactured by Quadrant Foundries, the Summer Beach series of firearms perfectly blends various beach elements onto the barrel. In tranquil moments, you might even hear the echo of the waves.

Tips.SourceString: “龙腾虎跃”系列涂装，以黄白二色凸显喜庆之感，刻画舞狮的剪刀手队员们跃然而上，凸显龙马精神。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Lion Dance" series features a festive yellow and white design, depicting Scissors members performing lion dances, embodying spirit and vitality.

Tips.SourceString: “暗金浪涌”系列主题涂装，由偏光实验室推出的枪械涂装，主打暗金色调，在保证酷炫拉风的同时，也颇具金属般的沉稳感与力量感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Golden Surge" series, launched by Polaris Labs, features a dark gold pattern that combines a cool, flashy look with a powerful sense of metallic stability.

Tips.SourceString: “飞鸟”系列主题涂装，生动描绘了多种鸟类动物的活泼生态，仔细观察似乎还被涂画上了使用者的个性符号。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Aviary" series imitates a lively avian ecosystem and subtly includes the user's personal symbol.

Tips.SourceString: “涂痕”系列涂装，为了让各地的来客能够深入体验乌尔比诺的潮流文化，长廊绘制所以喷漆，涂鸦为元素设计了一批枪械。派发在乌尔比诺各区的街头。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Graffiti series by Corridor Artisans creatively combines spray and street art elements, bringing Urbino's vibrant culture to life.

Tips.SourceString:
“谢幕曲”的定制版本，长廊绘制的精品之作。绚丽的荧光溢满枪身，保证能够命中粉丝的心。

【偶像就是要完美无瑕的哦！
所以，每一次狙击都要无比闪耀。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A custom version of Finale, a masterpiece by Corridor Artisans. Painted with brilliantly fluorescent colors, this gun is guaranteed to capture the fans' hearts.

"An idol must be flawless! Every shot should shine brilliantly."

Tips.SourceString:
“零时之约”的配套枪械客制化外观，简约华美的涂装下是对于一分一秒的珍惜。提醒着射手把握时间，准确适当地扣动扳机。 

【“时间啊，请你再慢一点，这样我就能命中那个人的心。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The "Midnight Pact" custom version features an elegant, minimalist design that symbolizes the value of time, reminding the user to take the shot at the perfect moment.

"Time, please slow down just a bit so I may capture their heart."

Tips.SourceString:
“谢幕曲”的个人定制款，将珍藏于心底的秘密回忆小心地收集起来，击中你的会是哪一个呢？

【用香奈美最珍贵的回忆，击中你的心！】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The "Finale" custom edition gathers cherished memories close to the heart. Which one will you be hit with?

"Kanami's most precious memory will capture your heart!"

Tips.SourceString:
“谢幕曲”的特别改装型，原本是配给香奈美的演出道具，但在令的巧思之下将其改造成了可以适合野外隐蔽使用的样式，但香奈美却觉得有些造型微妙……

【“野外怎么会有挂着价签的大葱啦！令先生！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The modded "Finale" model was originally just a performance prop for Kanami. With Reiichi's ingenuity, it's been transformed into a weapon for use in the wild. However, Kanami finds the design a bit peculiar.

"Why are there price tags on these wild spring onions?? Reiichi!!"

Tips.SourceString:
金树乐章音乐会的纪念品，以长笛作为灵感的改造枪械，当她拿起这把武器的时候是否回想起当时的回忆呢？

【“惊、惊喜已经传达到了吗？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A souvenir from the Golden Tree Symphony, this weapon is inspired by the design of a flute. Does she recall those memories when she wields it?

"D-Did they get the surprise?"

Tips.SourceString:
“谢幕曲”的个人定制款，钻石反射的能量光线流连于枪体之间，香奈美的签名预告函也隐蔽地夹在其中。

【“欢迎来到，香奈美的魔术世界！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized model of the "Finale." An energy beam reflected by diamonds flows within the barrel, where Kanami's signed announcement is carefully placed.

“Welcome to Kanami's magic world!”

Tips.SourceString:
“谢幕曲”的艺术特化型号，枪身蔚蓝如海，象征新生的绿叶点缀其中，传递着希望与温柔。

【“香奈美的心意，有通过戏剧表演传递给大家吗？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Finale artistic model combines sea-blue hue with fresh green leaves, symbolizing hope and renewal.

"Were Kanami's sentiments conveyed to everyone through the performance?"

Tips.SourceString:
“谢幕曲”的客制化改造款，配合超银河主题演唱会而设计，主打轻盈简约的科技风，枪身上的点点星光跟随舞台上的香奈美一同闪耀。

【“砰~！在繁星流转中，香奈美要成为你眼中最闪耀的那一颗！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized edition of the "Finale" for the Galactic Concert. It showcases a sleek, futuristic design with starry accents that shimmer in sync with Kanami on stage.

“Bang! I'll be the brightest among the swirling stars!”

Tips.SourceString:
“谢幕曲”的深海特供版，仿佛一滴蓝色眼泪轻轻落下，将枪体也染成了温柔而伤感的颜色。其间的流光萤火仿佛再现了那夜与你分别时的萤光大海。

【“明明才分别了一会儿而已，为什么会如此心痛呢？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Finale deep-sea edition resembles a gentle blue teardrop, tinting the gun with a tender, melancholic hue. The shimmering lights evoke memories of the glowing ocean on our farewell night.

"We've only just parted, so why does my heart ache so deeply?"

Tips.SourceString:
“谢幕曲”的特别改装型，以雪地中的红梅为设计主题，料峭嶙峋的枝桠缠绕枪管，似乎能闻到雪地里传来的幽幽梅花香。

【“这样的景象会让你想到大雪后的梅花林吗？那香奈美，或许就是树梢上那只唱歌的小鸟哦。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Inspired by red plums in the snow, this unique modification of Finale features rugged branches winding around the barrel, capturing the delicate scent of blossoms in winter.

"Does this image remind you of a snowy plum forest? Perhaps Kanami is like the little bird singing from the treetops."

Tips.SourceString:
“谢幕曲”的豪华定制版，不仅选用了熠熠生辉的钻石和环绕的音符装饰枪身，而且配备了极其先进的瞄准镜座，以其精湛的工艺和卓越的性能，成为了抑制敌人最强大的武器。

【“此时此刻，请带着回忆与我共鸣！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The luxury edition of Finale features sparkling diamonds and swirling musical notes on the barrel. With exquisite craftsmanship and an advanced aiming system, it stands as a formidable weapon for suppressing foes.

"Gather your memories and resonate with me!"

Tips.SourceString: 狙击步枪，且是战术干预型狙击步枪，一款将精度、威力与隐蔽性完美结合的枪械，曾是古地球狙击步枪中射程最远的的型号，配备2.5倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: This tactical intervention sniper rifle perfectly combines precision, power, and stealth. Once the longest-range model among Earth's sniper rifles. Equipped with a 2.5x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “伏击”系列涂装，经典迷彩款式，适合多种作战环境。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Bushwhack" series camo design suits various combat environments.

Tips.SourceString: “彩斑”系列涂装，以复数颜料色带涂抹而成，看似随性，却有艺术的气息喷薄而出。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the Colorburst series. Painted with streaks of different pigments. This firearm has a casual vibe, but it's overflowing with artistic flair.

Tips.SourceString: “警戒”系列涂装，PUS-04定制款，鲜明醒目，欧泊阵营中随处可见。
Tips.LocalizedString: The popular P.U.S-04 Vigilance adds a bright and distinctive finish to the P.U.S arsenal.

Tips.SourceString: “雷火”系列涂装，橙灰交错，复古的同时融入了潮流元素。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Thunderfire series blends contemporary sleekness with retro orange-gray elements.

Tips.SourceString: “碎梦”系列涂装，由不规则蓝色色块堆叠而成，图案中偶尔掺杂少量黄色碎片，给人以强烈的破碎感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Dreambreaker series combines patchy blues with occasional yellow fragments for a striking, shattered effect.

Tips.SourceString: “炫彩”系列涂装，由大量六边形色块重叠而成，斑斓的色彩效果甚至令人有种火力增强的错觉。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Vivid" series. Made up of a variety of overlapping hexagonal color blocks, this firearm's streams of color give off the illusion of added firepower.

Tips.SourceString: “冲浪”系列涂装，使用简约的色块勾勒出了沙滩与海浪的景象，拿在手上仿佛也能乘上海浪勇往直前。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Wave Surfer" series evokes beachside wave imagery with its minimalist blockish color design.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“主角之星”系列枪械造型，为客户特殊定制个性化形象并将其融入枪身设计中，堪称定制枪械设计的典范。
Tips.LocalizedString: Protagonist Star series produced by Polaris Labs, a classic example of stylistic design incorporating the client's very specific demands.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“夏日派对”系列枪械造型，整体洋溢着轻松活跃的氛围，在战斗中甚至能起到鼓舞士气的作用。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Summer Party series by Polaris Labs exudes a relaxed and lively vibe. This firearm can boost morale even in the heat of battle.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“纸牌屋”系列枪械造型，枪身中央有着客户定制的艺术头像，四周环绕的卡牌装饰，俏皮中略带几分神秘。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series from Corridor Artisans gained its intriguing reputation from the client's meticulous requirements for an avatar encircled by decorative card elements.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“招财猫”系列枪械造型，以象征着开运的招财猫为设计锚点，表达了设计者对客户们的美好祝福。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Maneki-Neko" series by Polaris Labs uses the symbol of the good fortune cat as its design anchor, expressing the creator's best wishes for clients.

Tips.SourceString: “飞鸟”系列主题涂装，生动描绘了多种鸟类动物的活泼生态，仔细观察似乎还被涂画上了使用者的个性符号。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Aviary" series imitates a lively avian ecosystem and subtly includes the user's personal symbol.

Tips.SourceString: “涂痕”系列涂装，为了让各地的来客能够深入体验乌尔比诺的潮流文化，长廊绘制所以喷漆，涂鸦为元素设计了一批枪械。派发在乌尔比诺各区的街头。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Graffiti series by Corridor Artisans creatively combines spray and street art elements, bringing Urbino's vibrant culture to life.

Tips.SourceString:
“空境”的战术客制型号，采用原子朋克风格的设计思路，护手更为舒适，瞄具更为精准，比起原款式更适合远距离作战。

【那是原子朋克的世界。
那是不切实际的未来，是冰冷的乌托邦，是暗藏危机的永恒国度。
那是希望、幻想、隐匿的残酷，以及……注定遗憾的结局。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The tactical custom model of Quasar features an atomic-punk design, offering a more comfortable grip and advanced sights, making it ideal for long-range combat.

"That is the world of atomic-punk.
A world of an unrealistic future, a cold utopia, an eternal realm filled with hidden dangers.
It is a place of hope, fantasy, latent cruelty, and... an inevitably tragic end."

Tips.SourceString:
金树乐章音乐会的纪念品之一，心夏称其为最珍贵的宝物之一，拿着它的心夏就仿佛战场上的吟游诗人一般吸引着注意力，随后华丽地带走敌人。

【“要是能和你一直搞音乐，或许也不错？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
One of the Golden Tree Symphony concert souvenirs, Kokona regards it as one of her most treasured items. With this in hand, Kokona draws attention like a battlefield bard, then elegantly finishes off her foes.

"Maybe making music with you forever wouldn't be so bad?"

Tips.SourceString:
“空境”的私人订制型号，附带了大量鸭鸭主题要素，蕴含着乘风破浪的寓意。

【“任务完成！不愧是心夏前辈~”
“快点快点，说不定，我们还能赶上演唱会的最后一曲呢！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A custom Quasar model featuring many duck-themed elements, symbolizing the courage to ride waves.

“Mission accomplished! Well done, Kokona!”
“Hurry up, we can still make it for the last song!”

Tips.SourceString:
空境的特别改装版本，心夏尝试改造的野外装备之一，为了突出搭配感而特地做了一些单纯美观的雕花处理，与其说是武器，不如说是充满野性和装饰的艺术品。

【“嗯……会不会太华丽了？嘿嘿，不过我觉得正适合这个日子！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A modified version of the Quasar, one of Kokona's experiments with outdoor equipment. To enhance its aesthetic appeal, it features intricate decorative carvings. It's more of a wild work of art than a weapon.

'Hmm... Is it too fancy? Hehe, I think it's perfect for the occasion!'

Tips.SourceString:
“空境”的个性化改造款，以经典的旧时代战斗机为灵感，运用了空气动力学原理，减少了枪械飞行时的空气阻力。
——唯一的问题是，怎么让枪飞起来。

【唔……如果把枪械弦化是不是就能折成纸飞机了？】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A personalized version of Quasar. Inspired by classic fighter jets, it uses aerodynamics to reduce air resistance when the firearm is in motion—All that's left to figure out now is how to make the gun fly.

“Hmm... Maybe if we stringify the weapon, we can fold it into a paper airplane?”

Tips.SourceString:
“空境”的特殊改造型号，整体造型在原有的基础上加入了全新的喷涂工艺，精准的瞄具更是可以用来观测扫描机械故障，虽然只是小功能，但心夏却对这一改造十分喜欢。

【“心夏前辈，不要用那把枪老对着火力大喵看啦！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A modified version of Quasar featuring a new spray-paint process. Its precise sight can also be used to observe scanner malfunctions. Although it is only a minor improvement, Kokona has taken a liking to this modification.

"Kokona, please don't point your gun at Mighty Meow!"

Tips.SourceString:
“空境”的客制化改造款，为了纪念心夏在骑行比赛上胜利夺冠。在保证轻盈时尚的同时，枪身的设计还特别参考了自行车的动力学原理。

【“悄悄告诉你，我骑行的速度可是和子弹一样快哦。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized version of Quasar created to commemorate Kokona's victory in a cycling competition. Light and stylish, the barrel is designed with inspiration from bicycle dynamics.

“I'll tell you a secret: I am as fast as a bullet when I cycle.”

Tips.SourceString:
“空境”的美食大会限定款外观。夏夜的樱花飘舞，小小的烤摊前排了最长的队伍，为了不负期望，心夏挥汗如雨地烹调美味——这段混杂美味与汗水的记忆，心夏至今犹记在心。

【“心夏推荐花落谁家？不太记得了……但是我拿到了不少食客的第一推荐喔~”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Quasar’s exclusive culinary festival edition. Amidst dancing cherry blossoms on summer nights, Kokona works at her bustling stall, creating a fusion of effort and flavor she fondly recalls.

"Kokona's favorite pick? Hmmm, not sure... but many diners named me their top choice!"

Tips.SourceString:
“空境”的仿古定制版，按照“幻梦求真录”历史文化展览中的古文明壁画一比一复刻，执于手中，仿佛能将时间回溯，亲眼感受文明绚烂的那个年代。

【“锦绣河山如此秀美……画卷上的图景，要是可以再现就好了。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
This retro Quasar model replicates ancient murals from the "Dreams to Reality" historical exhibit. In your hands, it evokes an era of civilization's brilliance.

"The beauty of the land is unmatched... how I wish the painted scenes could truly appear."

Tips.SourceString: “空境”的古迹定制款，融入了希达半岛本土文化的元素，使现代枪械上呈现出了仿古材料的质感。据说携带它进入沙漠深处的人，可以获得这片土地的庇护。
Tips.LocalizedString: A custom relic edition of Quasar that blends elements of Seeda Peninsula's culture, giving modern firearms an ancient material feel. Legend has it that those who carry it into the desert's depths receive the land's protection.

Tips.SourceString: “空境”的校园日定制款，以手工部为灵感设计的涂装，在整体配色上非常协调统一。而那些简洁的方程式，也总能令人回想起课桌上的涂鸦。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Campus Open Day edition of Quasar draws inspiration from the crafting club, featuring a harmonized color scheme. The simple equations evoke memories of doodles on school desks.

Tips.SourceString:
夏日黄的共鸣体武装，拥有强大的远距离火力。共鸣体是机动天使的力量之源，来自维度裂隙之外的力量碎片，只有与特定的超弦体产生共鸣才能发挥真正的力量。
——热门动画《机动天使GEN》官方设定集VOL.2
Tips.LocalizedString:
A resonant version of the Summer Yellow featuring substantial long-range firepower. Resonants are fragments of energy from another dimension and the source of power for Mecha Angels. Their true potential is unleashed only when they resonate with specific Superstrings.

—Official Artbook of the popular anime "Mecha Angel GEN"

Tips.SourceString: 操控性良好、稳定耐用的射手步枪。亚诺斯在保留枪型基本特质的基础上，使用特制的偏重心彩溶弹药对远距离射击精度进行了一定的补正，配备2.5倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: This stable and durable marksman rifle offers excellent control. Its specially weighted rounds enhance long-range accuracy. Equipped with a 2.5x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “浪潮”系列涂装，以蓝色色块组合模拟海浪的造型，虽无潮声，却也沁人心脾。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Tidal Wave" series is composed of a series of blue modules meant to imitate the shape of a wave. It may lack the sound of the sea, but it remains a delight.

Tips.SourceString: “霓虹”系列涂装，SCIS-08定制款，叛逆不羁的色彩搭配，受到剪刀手阵营的青睐。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Neon" SCIS-08 custom edition showcases The Scissors' bold rebellion with its edgy color scheme.

Tips.SourceString: “紫金”系列涂装，别出心裁的紫金撞色搭配给予枪身别样的质感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Violet Gold series features a unique blend of purple and gold, giving the weapon a distinct texture.

Tips.SourceString: “迷彩”系列涂装，枪身上多样的色彩融合，很好地达到了融入自然环境的效果。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Camo" series. The firearm features perfect textures to blend seamlessly into natural environments.

Tips.SourceString: “信念”系列涂装，黑底，配上剪刀手徽记与涂鸦，肃杀中彰显出持有者坚定的意志。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Faith" series features a black base with The Scissors emblem, showcasing the holder's unwavering resolve.

Tips.SourceString: “魅紫”系列涂装，以明亮的紫色填充枪身，赋予枪身独特的神秘感。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Arcane Purple" series, this firearm, adorned in bright purple, exudes a sense of mystery.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“浪人”系列枪械造型，神秘迷幻的紫色枪身中仿佛有浪花跃动，抚慰着每一位浪人的心。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Ronin series produced by Quadrant Foundries features waves dancing on a mysterious and psychedelic purple background, soothing the hearts of many wandering warriors.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“夏日海滩”系列枪械造型，完美地将不同种类的海滩元素附着于枪身之上，宁静时刻，甚至能听见海潮的回响。
Tips.LocalizedString: Manufactured by Quadrant Foundries, the Summer Beach series of firearms perfectly blends various beach elements onto the barrel. In tranquil moments, you might even hear the echo of the waves.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“Q版世界”系列枪械造型，将定制者的Q版三视图融入视觉设计中，为枪身赋予轻松气息的同时，更好地满足了客制化需求。
Tips.LocalizedString: Manufactured by Quadrant Foundries, the "Chibi World" series of firearms features custom Chibi-style art, adding a relaxed vibe to the barrel while fulfilling customization needs.

Tips.SourceString: “纸牌屋”系列涂装，以红心黑方作为主题，身着华服的Q版剪刀手成员惟妙惟肖，彰显贵气之感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series features a tasteful heart and black square palette, adorned with elegant chibi versions of The Scissors, exuding a sense of luxury.

Tips.SourceString: “龙腾虎跃”系列涂装，以黄白二色凸显喜庆之感，刻画舞狮的剪刀手队员们跃然而上，凸显龙马精神。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Lion Dance" series features a festive yellow and white design, depicting Scissors members performing lion dances, embodying spirit and vitality.

Tips.SourceString:
以“破晓”为原型设计的远距离打击武器，象限工造的大成之作，相较于原型极大提升了射程和精准度，是战场上绝对王牌。

【隐匿于夜幕中的人们期待着光的到来，他们无数次仰望天空，试图从黑夜里中寻找踪迹。
直到那一抹微光划破夜空，将残存的希望一一点燃。
于是，黎明将至。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
Based on the original Dawn model, this long-range precision weapon is Quadrant Foundries' masterpiece, reigning as the ultimate ace on the battlefield.

"Cloaked in darkness, they await the light, scanning the sky for signs. A lone glimmer cuts through, igniting hope and signaling the arrival of dawn."

Tips.SourceString:
“致命忠仆”的配套枪械客制化外观，由令亲自设计改装，武器与雨伞的一体两用，是他个人奇思与艺术美学的体现。

【“这样一来，就算不下雨的时候也能用得上雨伞了。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The "Lethal Servant" personalized version, designed and modified by Reiichi, serves as both a weapon and an umbrella, showcasing his unique ideals and aesthetics.

"This way, you can use the umbrella even when it's not raining."

Tips.SourceString:
“破晓”的个人定制款，适合水边使用。枪管上安装有三叉戟装置，杀气狰狞，摄人心魄。

【说不定，现在正有猎人对我们虎视眈眈……
开玩笑的，别被吓到了。现在，我们才是猎人。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A custom Dawn model, perfect for waterside use. The barrel sports a trident for an intimidating look.

"A hunter might be watching us at this very moment... Relax. We're the hunters now."

Tips.SourceString:
“破晓”的个性化定制型，枪身的流线感得以加强的同时加装了令认为十分符合太空幻想的装饰金属，似乎还有一部分太阳能板的碎片，但究竟是用来做什么的呢？只有令这个大发明家自己明白吧。

【“太阳能板的作用？我当时只是寻思这东西是不是能给枪提供点额外作用，但很可惜，实验失败了。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized version of the Dawn featuring an enhanced streamlined design and decorative metal that Reiichi finds befitting for the theme of space fantasy. There also appear to be fragments of a solar panel, but what are they used for? Only Reiichi, the inventor, knows the answer.

【“What is the solar panel used for? I figured it would provide extra functions to the gun. Unfortunately, that's a failed experiment.”】

Tips.SourceString:
令的尝试改造装备之一，为了符合黑市特色而对枪身进行了改造，足以称得上是优秀的艺术品，虽然装饰是假的，但杀伤力是真的。

【“真作假时假亦真,假作真时真亦假。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
One of Reiichi's modified weapons. The firearm's design has been altered to reflect a black market aesthetic. It’s an excellent piece of art—the decorations may be fake, but its lethality is real.

"When true is false, false is true; when false is true, true is false."

Tips.SourceString:
“破晓”的特别改装款，将棋子融入枪械设计，是为西洋棋表演赛专门定制的专属款式。令在原型的基础上进行了一些私人改装，重制了枪身的飞马造型还有花纹样式。

【“这些一个接一个的陷阱，你能看破几个？又能跳出几个？争取优势的机会时间往往是很短暂的。听见了吗？滴答。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized "Dawn" model with chess pieces in its design, crafted for a chess exhibition match. Reiichi made personal tweaks to the prototype, redesigning the pegasus frame and its unique patterns.

"Can you outsmart my traps and break free? Opportunities for advantage are brief. Hear that? Tick-tock."

Tips.SourceString:
“破晓”的特别改装型，在森林环境中，为了降低战场辨识度而设计的拟态造型，同时将修理工具并入其中，兼顾了近身战的特殊情况，但作为狙击手，令希望它永远不要派上用场。

【“修理是需要工具的，各种意义上。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special version of "Dawn," designed for camouflage in forests to reduce visibility, with built-in repair tools for close combat scenarios. However, as a sniper, Reiichi hopes they never need to be used.

"You need tools to repair stuff, whatever it is."

Tips.SourceString: 精准度较之普通步枪更优良，对不同口径、凝胶比例的彩溶弹适应力强，可提供稳定的持续作战射速，为队伍的推进提供可靠火力支援。
Tips.LocalizedString: Superior accuracy to ordinary rifles and strong adaptability to tracer rounds of various calibers and types. Outputs a stable and sustained rate of fire, providing reliable support on the field.

Tips.SourceString: 半自动战斗霰弹枪，拥有较高的可靠性与耐久性，鬼环式机械瞄具能够更准确地瞄准目标，配备1.25倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: Highly reliable and durable, this semi-automatic combat shotgun features ghost ring sights for improved accuracy. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

Tips.SourceString: “秘纹”系列涂装，靛蓝色块搭配橙色纹路，加之独具特色的图形标志，曾一度引领涂装审美的浪潮。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Mystic Mark series's eye-catching indigo blocks laced with beautiful orange lines once found considerable favor in the community.

Tips.SourceString: “多维”系列涂装，以卡拉彼丘图案为设计锚点，简约却不简单的图形中，流溢着别样的设计魅力。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Multiverse" series features a Strinova-inspired design. Its simple yet intricate patterns exude a unique charm.

Tips.SourceString: “热情”系列涂装，URB-00定制款，艳丽乖张的色彩彰显最为新潮的理念，深受乌尔比诺成员们的喜爱。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Ardor" series, URB-00 custom edition, features vibrant, edgy colors that reflect the latest trends, and is a favorite among Urbino members.

Tips.SourceString: “错觉”系列涂装，以蓝色调为主，混合扭曲的色彩看似在流动一般，表现出复杂动态的变形之美。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Illusion" series, this firearm's blue highlights twist and turn, as if melting into the design.

Tips.SourceString: “嵌合”系列涂装，深浓浅淡，错落有致的橙色马赛克涂装，带来独特而充满视觉效果的艺术感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Chimera" series features an elegant orange mosaic design with deep and light tones, creating an artistic look.

Tips.SourceString: “棱镜”系列涂装，不同深浅的紫红色调，仿佛在棱镜碎片中折射，显现出万花筒一般的美感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Prisma" series uses refractive fragmentation, with artistic purple shades evoking a kaleidoscopic feeling.

Tips.SourceString: “交错线”系列涂装，以暗色为敌，用交叉，叠加的线条作为主要的图形，在视觉上具有一定的迷惑性。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Crisscross series features a dark base with intersecting lines, creating a dazzling display on the battlefield.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“占星”系列枪械造型，神秘与潮流的结合，长廊绘制所内画师们的呕心沥血之作。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Astrologist" series by Corridor Artisans is a careful blend of mystery and trend, said to be the painstaking work of their top artist.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“漫画之星”系列枪械造型，于枪身中央增添了客户定制的艺术头像，配以精心搭配的色块设计，更好地还原了客户们的个性化需求。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Manga Star" series by Corridor Artisans showcases a customized avatar at the center of the gun, enhanced with thoughtfully designed color blocks to accentuate clients' unique preferences.

Tips.SourceString: “纸牌屋”系列涂装，以绿心桃形作为主体，充满活力的乌尔比诺成员今天也在为了自由和艺术而战。
Tips.LocalizedString: A model in the "House of Cards" series, coveted by Urbino fighters who favor bringing this artistic weapon into battle.

Tips.SourceString: “飞鸟”系列主题涂装，生动描绘了多种鸟类动物的活泼生态，仔细观察似乎还被涂画上了使用者的个性符号。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Aviary" series imitates a lively avian ecosystem and subtly includes the user's personal symbol.

Tips.SourceString: “暗金浪涌”系列主题涂装，由偏光实验室推出的枪械涂装，主打暗金色调，在保证酷炫拉风的同时，也颇具金属般的沉稳感与力量感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Golden Surge" series, launched by Polaris Labs, features a dark gold pattern that combines a cool, flashy look with a powerful sense of metallic stability.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“幻海”系列枪械造型，将海洋元素融入枪身之内，又附以如梦似幻的渐变配色，大大加强了枪械的整体艺术感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Mystic Ocean" series by Corridor Artisans beautifully blends oceanic elements with dreamlike gradient colors, enhancing the firearm's artistic appeal.

Tips.SourceString:
“自由意志”改型，长廊绘制所倾力打造，无论是性能、机动性还是稳定性，甚至连设计理念都远超同期作品，堪称跨时代的飞跃。

【在无羁的时代里，自由将不再是口号！
所以，不要把我关起来啊！】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A modified version of the Freedom Reign, crafted by Corridor Artisans. It excels in performance, maneuverability, stability, and design concept, making it a groundbreaking achievement of its era.

"In this unfettered era, freedom is more than just a slogan!
So, don't lock me up!"

Tips.SourceString:
“自由意志”的概念客制型号，白墨独家打造，别具一格的大胆设计令人叹为观止。据说这把枪的造型，是为了纪念他过去的某个小爱好……

【你不会真以为我想当一个面包师吧？不要乱传啊，那是谣言，谣言！】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized concept version of the Freedom Reigns made by Bai Mo featuring a breathtaking bold design. It is rumored that the shape of the gun pays tribute to one of his past hobbies...

【Did you really believe that I wanted to become a baker? Don't tell anybody that. It's a rumor! A rumor!】

Tips.SourceString:
“自由意志”的私人定制型号，使用了大量金属，打造出仿佛装卸工具般的质地，常让人误判它的实战力——要知道，“强效制动”可不止是个名字而已。

【既要尽情冲刺，也需及时刹车。收放自如，这也是乌尔比诺之道。】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Freedom Reigns custom job heavily leans into its metallic base reminiscent of freight machinery, often leading others to fatally underestimate its strength in battle. After all, it's not called a "Power Brake" for nothing.

"You can't sprint without mastering how to brake. Absolute control—that's the Urbino way."

Tips.SourceString:
“自由意志”的个人定制款，解放了原型中的所有潜力，如同一头横冲直撞的野牛，想驾驭它可不容易。

【这就是摆脱一切束缚的感觉！】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The custom model of Freedom Reign unleashes all the potential of the original, like an untamable charging bull.

"This is what breaking free feels like!"

Tips.SourceString:
“自由意志”的独家定制款。霓虹变色的怪盗标志与"BAIMO"签名让它在夜晚格外显眼，当然，一切都符合白墨的期待。

【“跟我读，白——墨。哈哈，与我冲刺吧，让光芒重现！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
An exclusive Freedom Reign custom edition. With a neon color-changing phantom emblem and "BAIMO" signature, it shines brightly at night, just as Baimo intended.

"Repeat after me, Bai...Mo. Haha, let's dash forward and light up the night!"

Tips.SourceString:
金树乐章音乐时白墨所使用的乐器改制武器，将原本的低音号喇叭口装在了枪口上，虽然不知道是否能扩大威力，但至少更加“自由”了。

【“帅啊！朋友！让我们再来一曲！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A weapon modified from the instrument Bai Mo used during the Golden Tree Symphony. The tuba's bell is attached to the muzzle. Although it is unclear whether it increases firepower, but it definitely feels more “free.”

"Nice one, my friend! Let's play another song!"

Tips.SourceString:
“自由意志”的地下酒吧特供版，去除了繁杂的装饰，更加适合贴身携带。

【“地下酒吧的老板带着枪，这不是很正常的事情吗？如果真的有危险降临，我得为客人们清理出一条生还之路嘛。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special underground bar edition of Freedom Reign. With excessive decorations removed, it is more suitable as an everyday carry.

"Isn't it normal for a bar owner to carry a gun? If danger ever strikes, I need to clear a path to safety for my guests."

Tips.SourceString:
“自由意志”的盟主选举特供版，保留了白墨最中意的绿色涂装，添加了他在喷漆比赛中赢下的小饰品。或许乌尔比诺的全新时代将在一声叛逆不羁的枪鸣之下打响。

【“新时代，就用这枚叛逆的子弹来揭开序幕吧！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The special election edition of Freedom Reign, featuring Bai Mo's favorite green design with added trinkets won from spray-paint competitions. With a single rebel gunshot, Urbino's new era may be set into motion.

“Let this rebellious bullet herald the dawn of a new era!”

Tips.SourceString:
“自由意志”的锦标赛特供版，设计元素取自某个经典影视剧形象出场时骑的摩托。枪械造型坚硬锐利，尽显冷酷本色。

【“穿着炫酷皮衣、骑着摩托车疾驰在夜色中，这样的我更适合终结比赛！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The championship edition of Freedom Reign draws inspiration from the iconic motorcycle of a classic film character. Its weapon design is sharp and fierce, showcasing a cool, ruthless style.

"Racing through the night in a slick leather jacket on a motorcycle—this is how I was meant to finish the race!"

Tips.SourceString:
“自由意志”的电玩比赛特供版，复古而充满童趣的色调，让人回想起最初接触游戏时的那份快乐。

【“果然，勇者斗魔龙就是经久不衰的主题嘛！等等，你说你要扮演魔龙……？】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Freedom Reign arcade-exclusive edition features retro, playful colors that evoke the joy of your first gaming experiences.

"Turns out, the hero vs dragon theme never gets old! Wait, you want to be the dragon...?"

Tips.SourceString:
这是白墨直播间出现过的无数宝贝之一，也是出镜率最高的一个。白墨使用这把造型奇特的武器进行战斗、演奏音乐、喊麦饶舌，偶尔也让它充当棒球棍，敲在当街发疯的真·瘾君子头上。粉丝们熟悉它就像熟悉白墨本人。

刚来，还没开播吧？！！！
今天会玩点什么，已经开始期待了！
在凌晨两点开直播，主播真有你的……
楼上弹幕笑死，那你还不是连滚带爬地来了？承认吧，你染上白墨了！
呃……什么意思？怎么只有把枪摆在这，主播人呢？
喂喂喂，你们看，直播间的标题变了……“主播请假，武器代播？”
？？？
逗我吧这是……但，基于你是白墨……就姑且看看你的枪能玩出点什么花样……
Tips.LocalizedString:
One of the many items Bai Mo uses in his livestreams and also the most frequently showcased. Bai Mo uses this uniquely designed weapon for combat, playing music, rapping, and occasionally as a baseball bat to knock sense into lunatics. Fans know it as well as they know the streamer himself.

Just got here. The stream hasn't started yet, has it?!!!
What's on the menu today? I can't wait!
Streaming at 2 in the morning? You've got guts...
LOL at the comment above. You're here, aren't you? Admit it, you're addicted to Bai Mo!
Uh... What's going on? Why is there only a gun here? Where is Bai Mo?
Hey, Look! The title of the stream changed... "Streamer on Leave, Weapon Taking Over?"
???
You've got to be kidding me... Since this is Bai Mo's stream... I guess I'll stick around and see what tricks the gun can pull off...

Tips.SourceString: 全自动战斗霰弹枪，无可匹敌。
Tips.LocalizedString: Fully automatic combat shotgun. There's nothing quite like it.

Tips.SourceString: “魅紫”系列涂装，以明亮的紫色填充枪身，赋予枪身独特的神秘感。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Arcane Purple" series, this firearm, adorned in bright purple, exudes a sense of mystery.

Tips.SourceString: “浪潮”系列涂装，以蓝色色块组合模拟海浪的造型，虽无潮声，却也沁人心脾。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Tidal Wave" series is composed of a series of blue modules meant to imitate the shape of a wave. It may lack the sound of the sea, but it remains a delight.

Tips.SourceString: “霓虹”系列涂装，SCIS-08定制款，叛逆不羁的色彩搭配，受到剪刀手阵营的青睐。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Neon" SCIS-08 custom edition showcases The Scissors' bold rebellion with its edgy color scheme.

Tips.SourceString: “紫金”系列涂装，别出心裁的紫金撞色搭配给予枪身别样的质感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Violet Gold series features a unique blend of purple and gold, giving the weapon a distinct texture.

Tips.SourceString: “迷彩”系列涂装，枪身上多样的色彩融合，很好地达到了融入自然环境的效果。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Camo" series. The firearm features perfect textures to blend seamlessly into natural environments.

Tips.SourceString: “信念”系列涂装，黑底，配上剪刀手徽记与涂鸦，肃杀中彰显出持有者坚定的意志。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Faith" series features a black base with The Scissors emblem, showcasing the holder's unwavering resolve.

Tips.SourceString: “交错线”系列涂装，以暗色为敌，用交叉，叠加的线条作为主要的图形，在视觉上具有一定的迷惑性。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Crisscross series features a dark base with intersecting lines, creating a dazzling display on the battlefield.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“浪人”系列枪械造型，神秘迷幻的紫色枪身中仿佛有浪花跃动，抚慰着每一位浪人的心。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Ronin series produced by Quadrant Foundries features waves dancing on a mysterious and psychedelic purple background, soothing the hearts of many wandering warriors.

Tips.SourceString: “暗金浪涌”系列主题涂装，由偏光实验室推出的枪械涂装，主打暗金色调，在保证酷炫拉风的同时，也颇具金属般的沉稳感与力量感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Golden Surge" series, launched by Polaris Labs, features a dark gold pattern that combines a cool, flashy look with a powerful sense of metallic stability.

Tips.SourceString: 由象限工造出品的“夏日海滩”系列枪械造型，完美地将不同种类的海滩元素附着于枪身之上，宁静时刻，甚至能听见海潮的回响。
Tips.LocalizedString: Manufactured by Quadrant Foundries, the Summer Beach series of firearms perfectly blends various beach elements onto the barrel. In tranquil moments, you might even hear the echo of the waves.

Tips.SourceString: “龙腾虎跃”系列涂装，以黄白二色凸显喜庆之感，刻画舞狮的剪刀手队员们跃然而上，凸显龙马精神。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Lion Dance" series features a festive yellow and white design, depicting Scissors members performing lion dances, embodying spirit and vitality.

Tips.SourceString: 格罗夫集团出品，“回味时光”咖啡厅同名主题涂装，依据持有者的喜好进行了个性化设计。不论是难眠的深夜，亦或是悠闲的午后，这杯咖啡都为你带来了一段值得回味的香浓时光。
Tips.LocalizedString: Produced by Grove Enterprises, the "Café Reminiscence" themed design is personalized according to the owner's taste. Whether it's a restless night or a relaxing afternoon, this coffee will bring you a rich and memorable experience.

Tips.SourceString:
“鸣火”的客制化枪械外观，依照高中生中最流行的时尚潮流而设计，枪管中迸射的火焰如青春一般放肆激扬。

【“燃起来吧，这才够青春！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The custom design of Wildfire draws inspiration from the latest high school fashion trends. Flames shooting from the barrel symbolize youthful energy.

"Woo! Fire it up!"

Tips.SourceString:
“鸣火”的客制化改造款，艾卡将她认为最喜欢的太空元素注入其中，并装配了能够模拟火焰的特别装置，毕竟，她的梦想是成为宇宙中最酷最燃的送货员。

【“谁能想到曾经的小火花，能够燃动整片宇宙呢？”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized "Wildfire" with Eika's favorite space elements and a special flame-simulation device. After all, her dream is to be the coolest, most fired-up courier in the universe.

"Who would have thought that a little spark could light up the entire universe?"

Tips.SourceString:
“鸣火”的深海特供版，涂装样式参照了艾卡最喜欢的海洋鱼类，炽色的花纹仿佛与艾卡的火花一样闪亮鲜艳。

【“火花小鱼炽焰橙，堂堂登场！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Wildfire deep sea edition is inspired by Eika's favorite fish, featuring vibrant patterns that shine as brightly as Eika's sparks.

"Flicker Fin in blazing orange, making a grand entrance!"

Tips.SourceString:
”鸣火“的医用特供版，巧妙地将子弹包装成了药丸的外观，以降低外在的威胁感，希望被它对准的人也有同感。
【“你的病历上得加受到枪击这一项了。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A special medical model of Wildfire. Its bullets are cleverly shaped like pills to appear less threatening. That's the hope, anyway.

"We'll have to add 'gunshot wound' to your medical history."

Tips.SourceString:
”鸣火“的沙漠特化版，传闻该枪械能够实现使用者的三个愿望，不过，她现在的持有者更希望通过自己的行动达成目的。

【“我的愿望，就是打败你们！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A desert edition of Wildfire, rumored to grant three wishes. Yet, its current owner chooses to reach her goals through her own efforts.

“I wish to defeat all my enemies!”

Tips.SourceString:
“鸣火”的打歌舞台特供版，粉黑配色加上经典格纹，让人不禁联想到少女的校服裙摆。下课后，就成为偶像吧！

【“如果站在舞台上能让大家听清我想说的话，那么我艾卡，一定会成为最令人瞩目的偶像！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
A customized stage version of the Wildfire. Its pink-black color scheme and classic plaid pattern bring one back to their school days. Class is over—time to shine as an idol!

“If standing on a stage is what gets me heard, then I'll give it my all and become the most captivating idol the world has ever seen!”

Tips.SourceString:
“鸣火”的游乐园定制款涂装，以在小孩中人气颇高的怪兽马戏团为设计灵感。

【“也许在游乐园结束营业后，这些装饰性的怪兽玩偶和雕像会动起来也说不定哦？那才是真正的奇迹！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Wildfire theme park edition is inspired by the popular Monster Circus, a childhood favorite show of Eika’s.

"Maybe when the park closes, these decorative monster dolls come to life. Now that would be a real miracle!"

Tips.SourceString:
“鸣火”的特殊定制款，凝聚着剪刀手其他成员对艾卡的关心和爱护。设计、材料收集、组装、更新，都由剪刀手的其他成员分别完成，当这把枪最后被交到艾卡手上时，她无比确认，这一定会是重装战姬最好的伙伴、最强的帮手。

【“凝聚着剪刀手众人意志的武器啊，在艾卡面前展现出你真正的实力！——欸欸欸串台了……”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The special edition of Wildfire embodies the care and support of Eika's fellow Scissors members. Every step, from creation to assembly, was handled by her teammates. Upon receiving it, Eika felt certain it was her best companion in combat.

"Mighty weapon born of The Scissors' will, reveal your strength with Eika!—Oops, wrong script..."

Tips.SourceString: 通用机枪，在古地球的某次人类大规模战争时期，曾是经典的收割型武器，其威力与性能可见一斑。配备1.25倍瞄准镜。
Tips.LocalizedString: Known for its remarkable power and performance, this general-purpose machine gun was a classic sweeper weapon from old Earth's large-scale wars. Equipped with a 1.25x scope.

Tips.SourceString: "彩斑"系列涂装，以复数颜料色带涂抹而成，看似随性，却有艺术的气息喷薄而出。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the Colorburst series. Painted with streaks of different pigments. This firearm has a casual vibe, but it's overflowing with artistic flair.

Tips.SourceString: "雷火"系列涂装，橙灰交错，复古的同时融入了潮流元素。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Thunderfire series blends contemporary sleekness with retro orange-gray elements.

Tips.SourceString: "碎梦"系列涂装，由不规则蓝色色块堆叠而成，图案中偶尔掺杂少量黄色碎片，给人以强烈的破碎感。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Dreambreaker series combines patchy blues with occasional yellow fragments for a striking, shattered effect.

Tips.SourceString: "警戒"系列涂装，PUS-04定制款，鲜明醒目，欧泊阵营中随处可见。
Tips.LocalizedString: The popular P.U.S-04 Vigilance adds a bright and distinctive finish to the P.U.S arsenal.

Tips.SourceString: “落日”系列定制涂装，橙白色的渐变预示着敌人的黑夜将至。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Sunset" series features a tasteful orange-white gradient, symbolizing the coming of twilight.

Tips.SourceString: “炫彩”系列涂装，由大量六边形色块重叠而成，斑斓的色彩效果甚至令人有种火力增强的错觉。
Tips.LocalizedString: From the "Vivid" series. Made up of a variety of overlapping hexagonal color blocks, this firearm's streams of color give off the illusion of added firepower.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“夏日派对”系列枪械造型，整体洋溢着轻松活跃的氛围，在战斗中甚至能起到鼓舞士气的作用。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Summer Party series by Polaris Labs exudes a relaxed and lively vibe. This firearm can boost morale even in the heat of battle.

Tips.SourceString: “禁区”系列涂装，为适应科斯迷特沙漠环境而进行再配色的制式涂装，有着良好的隐蔽性。其上的警示图标也是准入该地区的“凭证”之一。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Forbidden" series showcases a standard paint job adapted for improved concealment in Cosmite's environment. Its pronounced warning label is as good as any permit.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“招财猫”系列枪械造型，以象征着开运的招财猫为设计锚点，表达了设计者对客户们的美好祝福。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "Maneki-Neko" series by Polaris Labs uses the symbol of the good fortune cat as its design anchor, expressing the creator's best wishes for clients.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的“纸牌屋”系列枪械造型，枪身中央有着客户定制的艺术头像，四周环绕的卡牌装饰，俏皮中略带几分神秘。
Tips.LocalizedString: The "House of Cards" series from Corridor Artisans gained its intriguing reputation from the client's meticulous requirements for an avatar encircled by decorative card elements.

Tips.SourceString: 由长廊绘制所出品的卡丘夺旗阵营战纪念款涂装，为了纪念在这届夺旗阵营战中勇于参与、有优秀表现的选手。阵营战虽然已经结束，但对胜利和荣誉的追求永远不会过时。
Tips.LocalizedString: A commemorative skin from Corridor Artisans for the Strinova Capture the Flag Championship. This skin celebrates the players who bravely participated and performed admirably. Though the championship has concluded, the pursuit of victory and honor never goes out of style.

Tips.SourceString:
“校准仪”的仿古定制版，按照“幻梦求真录”历史文化展览中的古文明壁画一比一复刻，执于手中，仿佛能将时间回溯，亲眼感受文明绚烂的那个年代。

【“有祥瑞兽的庇佑，这亭台楼阁，定能顺利拔地而起。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
This retro Calibrator model replicates ancient murals from the "Dreams to Reality" historical exhibit. In your hands, it evokes an era of civilization’s brilliance.

"Under the beast's blessing, the pavilion shall stand tall."

Tips.SourceString:
“校准仪”的电玩定制版，以蕾欧娜小时候最爱玩的格斗游戏为设计元素，那份按出隐藏连招的畅快感，无论时间过去多久，她都会记得。

【“接下吧！这代表着正义的炫酷连招！”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The arcade-themed Calibrator draws inspiration from Leona's favorite childhood fighting game. She'll always remember the nostalgia of executing secret combos.

"Take this! It's the ultimate justice combo!"

Tips.SourceString: 自动步枪，因使用全威力步枪弹，而具有较强的战斗性，能适应全天候作战。配备1.5倍瞄准镜，可在半自动射击模式与全自动射击模式之间切换。
Tips.LocalizedString: This automatic rifle uses high-powered rounds for superior combat effectiveness, perfect for all-weather operations. Equipped with a 1.5x scope and switchable between semi-automatic and automatic modes.

Tips.SourceString: “涂痕”系列涂装，为了让各地的来客能够深入体验乌尔比诺的潮流文化，长廊绘制所以喷漆，涂鸦为元素设计了一批枪械。派发在乌尔比诺各区的街头。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Graffiti series by Corridor Artisans creatively combines spray and street art elements, bringing Urbino's vibrant culture to life.

Tips.SourceString: “掠食者”系列涂装，仿生迷彩的设计不仅提供了良好的复杂环境隐蔽能力，也象征着战士们强大的武力。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Predator series features a bionic camo design, offering excellent camouflage in complex environments.

Tips.SourceString: 由偏光实验室出品的“夏日派对”系列枪械造型，整体洋溢着轻松活跃的氛围，在战斗中甚至能起到鼓舞士气的作用。
Tips.LocalizedString: The Summer Party series by Polaris Labs exudes a relaxed and lively vibe. This firearm can boost morale even in the heat of battle.

Tips.SourceString:
“枫鸣”的搜查官射击竞赛定制款涂装，非常严谨地按照赛事规定做了色块控制和区分，与递交的报告样图没有分毫差异，恰如主人谨守法度的性格。

【“失之毫厘，谬之千里，命中靶心的准备，从武器的纹路就已经开始了。”】
Tips.LocalizedString:
The Maple Resonance competition edition is rigorously crafted to tournament standards, matching sample reports perfectly, embodying the owner's rule-abiding nature.

"Missing by an inch means missing by a mile; bullseye accuracy starts with the weapon's details."
